paper.title: Wiola 13M, a Gated Spiral Attention Architecture for Parameter Efficient Small Language Models
paper.abstract: Small language models in the ten to one hundred million parameter range are attractive for on device inference, rapid experimentation, and controlled scientific study, yet most of them reuse the standard transformer block without adaptation to the small scale regime. We present Wiola, a decoder only language model whose novelty is concentrated in three drop in components of every layer. First, Spiral Rotary Positional Encoding perturbs the standard rotary frequencies by a slowly growing per dime

summary.core_problem: 为 10M 到 100M 参数的小语言模型设计更适配小规模 regime 的 decoder-only 架构组件。
summary.importance: 这是小模型架构探索，价值在于低成本 ablation 和结构假设检验；但 13M 规模离现代基座模型训练区间较远，若没有跨规模验证，对大模型 pretrain 的结论只能当弱信号。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Wiola，在每层加入三个 drop-in 组件：Spiral RoPE 用按维度缓慢增长的因子扰动 RoPE 频率，试图增强长程位置区分；Gated Spiral Attention 从 query 流的因果累计统计生成每个 head 的内容自适应标量 gate，近似软 head selection；Butterfly FFN 用乘性交互和块内 bypass 替代常规 expansion FFN。
summary.experiments: 论文标题指向 13M 参数模型；摘要未提供训练 token 数、数据组成、baseline、困惑度、下游评测或消融数字。因此目前只能判断其架构设想，不能判断可扩展性。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper designs decoder-only architecture components tailored to small language models in the 10M-100M parameter range.
summary_en.importance: It is a small-model architecture study, useful mainly for cheap ablations and testing structural hypotheses. At 13M parameters, however, it is far from modern foundation-model training regimes, so any implication for large-scale pretraining should be treated as a weak signal unless scaling evidence is provided.
summary_en.technical_approach: Wiola adds three drop-in components to each layer: Spiral RoPE perturbs rotary frequencies with a slowly growing per-dimension factor for stronger long-range positional separation; Gated Spiral Attention derives a content-adaptive scalar gate per head from causal cumulative query statistics, approximating soft head selection; Butterfly FFN replaces the standard expansion block with multiplicative interactions and an intra-block bypass.
summary_en.experiments: The title indicates a 13M-parameter model. The abstract does not provide token count, data mixture, baselines, perplexity numbers, downstream results, or ablation details, so the current evidence mainly supports reading it as an architecture proposal rather than a scaling result.

recommendation.zh: 看架构图和消融表即可；13M 结果不能外推，但 query 统计做 head gate 这个假设可进小规模沙盒。
recommendation.en: Skim the architecture and ablations only; 13M evidence will not scale by default, but query-statistic head gating is sandbox-worthy.

paper.title: Not All Attention Is Equal: A Quantitative Survey of the EEI Trade-off
paper.abstract: Attention mechanisms have driven machine learning for a decade, from neural machine translation to language models that do general-purpose reasoning. This survey covers four connected threads: their formulation for sequence-to-sequence tasks, adaptation to computer vision, efficiency innovations that address the quadratic bottleneck, and advances in interpretability. We define three criteria: efficiency, expressiveness, and interpretability, and compare twenty-one methods using an EEI scoring fr

summary.core_problem: 注意力机制十年来衍生大量变体，缺乏在效率（efficiency）、表达力（expressiveness）、可解释性（interpretability）三维度下的系统比较，且细粒度排名是否可靠存疑。
summary.importance: 综述贡献：梳理从 Bahdanau/Luong 到 Transformer 及高效注意力的发展脉络，提出 EEI 三维评分框架比较 21 种方法；核心发现是排名在扰动下高度不稳定，只适合粗粒度分层比较。
summary.technical_approach: 单评分者对 21 种注意力方法按 EEI 三维打分（假设 ±1 分扰动），用 200,000 次确定性 Monte Carlo 分析排名稳定性，并与 rank-matched null model 对照。
summary.experiments: 67-70% 的样本中排名变化超过一位；null model 重现类似稳定性，表明细粒度排名不可靠，应仅做 tier-level 比较。

summary_en.core_problem: A decade of attention variants has produced no systematic comparison along efficiency, expressiveness, and interpretability, and the reliability of fine-grained rankings is questionable.
summary_en.importance: Survey contribution: traces attention from Bahdanau-Luong alignment through Transformers and efficient variants, proposing an EEI scoring framework across 21 methods; the key finding is that rankings are highly unstable under perturbation, supporting only coarse tier-level comparisons.
summary_en.technical_approach: A single rater scores 21 attention methods on EEI dimensions (assuming ±1-point perturbation), with 200,000-sample deterministic Monte Carlo analysis of rank stability, compared against a rank-matched null model.
summary_en.experiments: Rank changes of more than one position occur in 67-70% of samples; the null model reproduces a similar stability profile, indicating fine-grained rankings are unreliable.

recommendation.zh: 单评分者综述，结论（注意力排名不稳定）不算意外；作为注意力变体的文献地图备查即可，不值得通读。
recommendation.en: Single-rater survey whose conclusion (attention rankings are unstable) is unsurprising; keep as a literature map of attention variants but not worth a full read.

paper.title: Thought-Aware KV Cache Compaction for Reasoning via Adaptive Attention Matching
paper.abstract: Reasoning language models generate lengthy chain-of-thought (CoT) sequences whose key-value (KV) cache grows linearly and becomes a memory bottleneck during decoding. Existing compaction methods treat reasoning trajectories as flat token sequences and apply uniform compression, ignoring the hierarchical structure of CoT reasoning where different steps vary drastically in importance. We propose \textbf{Thought-Aware Attention Matching (TAM)}, which exploits this structure through three mechanisms

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作解决的是推理模型长 CoT 解码时的 KV cache 内存瓶颈。现有压缩方法通常把生成轨迹当作平坦 token 序列处理，统一分配压缩预算；作者认为 CoT 有步骤结构，不同 reasoning block 对未来生成的重要性差异很大，因此压缩预算也应按结构和重要性分配。
summary.importance: 这篇论文更偏推理效率和 serving，但对预训练研究也有间接启发。长推理能力如果依赖大量中间 token，训练和部署都会遇到 memory-time tradeoff。TAM 的结论说明，推理轨迹中的 token 并不等价；问题定义、中间结论和关键计算锚点比探索性或废弃路径更应保留。这对后续研究有两个影响：一是可以把 reasoning trace 看成可压缩的分层状态，而不是必须完整保留的文本；二是训练阶段可能需要让模型生成更可分段、更可压缩的推理轨迹。
summary.technical_approach: TAM 建在 Attention Matching 之上。Attention Matching 的目标不是简单丢 token，而是构造更短的 compact KV，使其在参考 query 上同时匹配局部 attention output 和 attention mass。TAM 加了三个结构化机制。第一，thought segmentation，把已经生成的推理轨迹切成若干 reasoning blocks。第二，adaptive budget allocation，根据每个 block 的重要性权重和长度分配 compact token 数，理论上给出 t_i ∝ sqrt(w_i n_i) 的分配规则；这比统一压缩更适合误差随预算递减的场景。第三，pivotal token protection，保留高 attention 的关键 token，避免被压缩过程抹掉。参考 query 来自最近 selector window，使方法适合 mid-trajectory compaction，而不是只在 prefill 阶段处理静态上下文。底层拟合仍使用 AM 的闭式或轻量求解流程，包括 attention mass 的非负最小二乘和 value 的普通最小二乘。
summary.experiments: 实验使用 Qwen3-4B，在 AIME 2024 和 MATH-500 上评估长推理场景下的压缩效果。作者报告 TAM 在相同 memory budget 下相比 uniform compaction 有更稳定的准确率收益；周期性 compaction 最高可降低约 65% peak memory。消融设计围绕三个部件展开：分段、按重要性分配预算、保护 pivotal tokens。核心结果是，单纯 uniform compression 在高压缩率下更容易损失关键 reasoning anchor，而 TAM 通过把预算集中在高权重 block 和关键 token 上，能在较低 KV 内存下保留更多解题性能。文中还给出理论支撑：预算分配规则在凸误差模型下最优，保护 pivotal token 可降低近似误差，连续多次压缩的累计误差有界。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议用 20 到 30 分钟。先看 Introduction 中对 AM、RPC 和 TAM 三者差异的定位：compaction primitive、query source、structure-aware budget allocation。然后看 Preliminaries 里 attention mass matching 的分解，这是理解为什么 AM 不等于 token eviction 的关键。方法部分重点读 segmentation、importance score、t_i ∝ sqrt(w_i n_i) 分配规则，以及 pivotal token 的定义。实验部分主要看不同压缩率下的 accuracy-memory 曲线和 ablation。若只关心 serving，可重点看 peak-memory reduction 和 compaction 周期；若关心预训练或推理建模，可重点看推理轨迹的分层结构假设。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets KV-cache growth during long chain-of-thought decoding. Existing cache compaction methods usually treat the generated reasoning trace as a flat token sequence and apply a uniform compression policy. TAM argues that reasoning traces have block structure, and that different blocks should receive different cache budgets because their relevance to future generation varies substantially.
summary_en.importance: The work is mainly about inference efficiency, but it has useful implications for reasoning-model training. Long reasoning is not only a capability problem; it also creates a memory and bandwidth problem. TAM shows that generated reasoning tokens are not equally useful: problem statements, intermediate results, and conclusion anchors deserve more preservation than abandoned explorations. This supports a view of reasoning traces as compressible hierarchical state, which may influence how models are trained to produce structured, reusable, and cache-friendly reasoning trajectories.
summary_en.technical_approach: TAM extends Attention Matching rather than relying on simple token eviction. Attention Matching constructs a shorter set of compact keys and values that match both local attention outputs and attention mass under a set of reference queries. TAM adds three mechanisms. First, it segments the generated trajectory into thought blocks. Second, it allocates the compression budget adaptively using each block’s importance and length, with an allocation rule of the form t_i proportional to sqrt(w_i n_i). Third, it protects pivotal tokens, identified as high-attention anchors, so that important reasoning states are not removed by the compaction step. Reference queries are drawn from a recent selector window, making the method suitable for mid-trajectory compaction during decoding. The underlying fitting still follows the AM pipeline, including nonnegative least squares for attention-mass matching and ordinary least squares for value fitting.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation uses Qwen3-4B on AIME 2024 and MATH-500. TAM improves accuracy over uniform compaction at the same memory budget, and periodic compaction reduces peak memory by up to about 65%. The ablations are organized around the three main components: thought segmentation, adaptive budget allocation, and pivotal-token protection. The reported pattern is consistent with the method’s premise: uniform compression loses important reasoning anchors at high compression ratios, while TAM spends more budget on high-importance blocks and preserves key tokens. The paper also provides theoretical support: the allocation rule is optimal under a convex error model, pivotal-token protection reduces approximation error, and sequential compaction has bounded cumulative error.
summary_en.reading_guide: A useful skim takes about 20 to 30 minutes. Start with the introduction’s comparison among Attention Matching, Reasoning Path Compression, and TAM, especially the distinction between the compaction primitive, the query source, and structure-aware budget allocation. Then read the preliminaries on attention-mass decomposition, since this explains why AM-style compaction differs from eviction. In the method section, focus on thought segmentation, the importance score, the sqrt(w_i n_i) budget rule, and pivotal-token protection. In the experiments, prioritize the accuracy-memory curves and the ablations. For serving work, the peak-memory and compaction-period results are the main pieces; for reasoning-model research, the more interesting part is the assumption that CoT traces form a compressible hierarchy.

recommendation.zh: 这篇值得看，因为它把“CoT 不是均匀 token 流”讲成了可操作的 cache 策略；先看方法图和误差界，再核对 memory budget 是否算干净。
recommendation.en: Worth reading because it operationalizes the idea that CoT is not a uniform token stream; read the method figure and error-bound section first, then verify whether the memory-budget accounting is actually clean.

paper.title: Spectral Outliers Reveal Dominant Learned Structure in Transformer Attention
paper.abstract: We apply Marchenko-Pastur (MP) random matrix theory to pre-trained attention weights in order to separate each projection matrix into a random-like bulk and a set of spectral outliers. We validate this decomposition causally: zeroing the MP-identified outliers (signal) in Mistral-7B drives HellaSwag, MMLU, and PIQA close to random-chance performance, whereas zeroing a count-matched subset of bulk singular values causes smaller but non-negligible degradation. Across 11 pre-trained transformers we

summary.core_problem: 如何从预训练Transformer注意力权重中分离结构化功能信号与类随机噪声，并因果验证这些结构成分对模型性能的实际贡献。
summary.importance: 提供了基于Marchenko-Pastur随机矩阵理论的无监督注意力结构诊断框架，其发现的谱异常值承载主要功能信息、GQA架构改变V投影结构分布等结论，可为参数高效微调的秩与层选择、模型压缩、注意力架构设计提供实证依据。
summary.technical_approach: 用Marchenko-Pastur（MP）定律对Q/K/V/O每个注意力投影矩阵的奇异值做分解，超过MP上界的归为谱异常值（结构化信号），其余为类随机体成分。配套三种分析手段：入口级异常值热图（可视化4σ以上权重的空间分布）、跨层残差流对齐分析（识别持续出现的异常残差通道）、因果消融实验（对比置零谱异常值与等量随机体成分的性能下降，验证功能重要性）。共分析11个覆盖编码器、解码器架构的预训练模型。
summary.experiments: 在Mistral-7B上置零MP识别的谱异常值，HellaSwag、MMLU、PIQA性能降至接近随机水平，置零等量随机体成分的下降幅度小得多。跨架构规律包括：Q投影的谱异常值最多（LLaMA-2-7B中Q占87.8%谱能量，V占79.0%）；GQA架构下V投影异常值大幅减少（LLaMA-3-8B中V仅占43.1%谱能量，较Q少6倍）；谱能量占比从低层到高层逐层递减。空间分布上Q异常值呈行带状、O呈列带状，K和O存在跨层持续的残差通道。
summary.reading_guide: 重点看第II节的MP分解方法与消融协议、第III节的跨架构谱模式与因果消融结果，预计阅读20-30分钟。关注参数高效微调或模型压缩可优先看谱异常值的功能验证部分，关注架构设计可重点看GQA对V投影结构的影响分析。

summary_en.core_problem: How to separate functionally meaningful structured signal from random-like noise in pre-trained Transformer attention weights, and causally validate whether the identified structures actually contribute to model performance.
summary_en.importance: Provides an unsupervised diagnostic framework for attention weight structure based on Marchenko-Pastur random matrix theory. Findings such as spectral outliers carrying dominant functional information and GQA altering the structural distribution of V projections offer empirical guidance for rank and layer selection in parameter-efficient fine-tuning, model compression, and attention architecture design.
summary_en.technical_approach: Decomposes each attention projection matrix (Q, K, V, O) into spectral outliers (singular values above the Marchenko-Pastur upper edge, treated as structured signal) and a random-like bulk using MP law. Three complementary analysis methods are included: entry-level outlier heatmaps (visualizing spatial distribution of weights above 4σ), cross-layer residual-stream alignment analysis (identifying persistent outlier residual channels), and causal ablation experiments (comparing performance degradation from zeroing spectral outliers vs an equal number of random bulk components to verify functional importance). Analyzes 11 pre-trained models spanning encoder-only and decoder-only architectures.
summary_en.experiments: Zeroing MP-identified spectral outliers in Mistral-7B drops HellaSwag, MMLU, and PIQA performance to near random chance, while zeroing an equal number of random bulk components causes far smaller degradation. Cross-architecture patterns include: Q projections have the most spectral outliers (87.8% spectral energy for Q vs 79.0% for V in LLaMA-2-7B); V projections under GQA have dramatically fewer outliers (only 43.1% spectral energy in LLaMA-3-8B, a 6x reduction relative to Q); spectral energy ratio decreases gradually from early to late layers. Spatially, outliers form row-bands in Q and column-bands in O, with persistent cross-layer residual channels in K and O.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section II for the MP decomposition method and ablation protocol, and Section III for cross-architecture spectral patterns and causal ablation results. Estimated reading time: 20-30 minutes. Readers interested in parameter-efficient fine-tuning or model compression should prioritize the functional validation of spectral outliers; those focused on architecture design can dive into the GQA impact analysis on V projection structure.

recommendation.zh: 谱分解+因果消融的 setup 干净，结论对结构化剪枝和 PEFT 有直接提示，重点看 §4-5 的五个 pattern。
recommendation.en: Clean spectral-plus-causal-ablation setup; the five patterns in §4-5 are directly useful for structured pruning and PEFT.

paper.title: Faster Query-Key Learning Sharpens Attention in Self-Attention Models
paper.abstract: A standard self-attention layer consists of two interacting circuits: the query-key circuit that governs attention allocation, and the output-value circuit that maps attended representations to predictions. Collapsed and factorized parameterizations of the query-key and output-value circuits lead to qualitatively different attention patterns. In particular, some parameterizations give sharper attention to task-relevant tokens, at a similar training loss. We analyze how the parameterizations of t

summary.core_problem: 在相同预测性能下，自注意力模型会出现差异极大的注意力模式；现有理论只解释了 Transformer 的表达能力，没有说明架构参数化方式与梯度优化如何共同塑造注意力结构，特别是 query-key 电路和 output-value 电路的相对学习速度如何影响注意力锐度。
summary.importance: 给出了注意力模式形成的机制性解释：不是表达能力差异，而是参数化和优化速度差异决定了注意力是否集中在任务相关 token 上。对预训练实践的直接启发是：可以通过调整 Q/K 与 O/V 的参数化形式或相对学习率，在不损失训练损失的前提下得到更可解释、更锐利的注意力，而不需要改动模型结构或数据。
summary.technical_approach: 将单层自注意力拆分为两个线性电路：query-key 电路（W_K W_Q^T，决定注意力分布）和 output-value 电路（W_O W_V，将注意力后的表示映射为预测 logits）。对比四种参数化：FAFO（两路都分解）、CAFO（注意力合并、输出分解）、FACO（注意力分解、输出合并）、CACO（两路都合并）。通过梯度流分析证明：分解式参数化会在对应的合并参数空间中引入状态依赖的梯度重缩放，使得分解模型和合并模型即使损失相近，优化轨迹也不同。在正交性与对称性假设下推导出闭式群体梯度流动力学：output-value 标量按 log(t) 增长，query-key 标量按 log^2(t) 增长，增长常数由两路学习率比值 η_QK / η_OV 控制。由于 query-key 电路通过饱和非线性（softmax）作用于注意力，这种增长速度差异直接解释了相对学习速度如何驱动注意力在训练过程中逐渐锐化。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖合成数据和三个带 token 级相关性标注的真实数据集：HateXplain、主谓一致数据集、SQuAD。核心观察：1）提升 query-key 电路相对学习速度，或使用分解式 Q/K 参数化，都会让注意力更集中在任务相关 token 上；2）上述改动对预测损失和下游任务指标几乎没有影响；3）合成数据上的参数演化轨迹与闭式动力学推导高度吻合，验证了 log(t) 与 log^2(t) 的增长规律。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读为主，预计 40-60 分钟。重点看：1）Introduction 中对两个电路的拆分和问题定义；2）第 3 节参数化对比与梯度流推导的核心结论（不必深究全部数学细节）；3）第 5 节真实数据实验的注意力可视化与定量指标。值得深挖的点：把该结论推广到多层、多头、大模型预训练的可行性；是否可以通过分组学习率调度直接控制注意力锐度，进而改善长上下文或可解释性。

summary_en.core_problem: Self-attention models with nearly identical predictive performance can develop drastically different attention patterns. Existing theory focuses on Transformer expressivity but does not explain how architectural parameterization and gradient-based optimization jointly shape attention structure — in particular, how the relative learning speed of the query-key circuit and the output-value circuit affects attention sharpness.
summary_en.importance: Provides a mechanistic account of attention pattern formation: differences in attention sharpness come from parameterization and optimization speed, not from differences in expressivity. A direct practical implication for pretraining is that one can obtain sharper, more interpretable attention on task-relevant tokens without changing model architecture or data, simply by adjusting the parameterization or relative learning rates of the Q/K and O/V paths.
summary_en.technical_approach: Decomposes a single-layer self-attention model into two linear circuits: the query-key circuit (W_K W_Q^T, which controls the attention distribution) and the output-value circuit (W_O W_V, which maps attended representations to prediction logits). Four parameterizations are compared: FAFO (both circuits factorized), CAFO (collapsed attention, factorized output), FACO (factorized attention, collapsed output), CACO (both collapsed). Gradient-flow analysis shows that factorized parameterizations induce a state-dependent rescaling of gradient updates in the corresponding collapsed parameter space, so factorized and collapsed models follow different optimization trajectories even when they reach similar losses. Under orthogonality and symmetry assumptions, closed-form population gradient-flow dynamics are derived: the output-value scalar grows as log(t), while the query-key scalar grows as log^2(t), with constants controlled by the learning-rate ratio η_QK / η_OV. Because the query-key circuit acts on attention through a saturating nonlinearity (softmax), this difference in growth rate directly explains how relative optimization speed drives attention sharpening during training.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments cover synthetic data and three real-world datasets with token-level relevance annotations: HateXplain, subject-verb agreement, and SQuAD. Key observations: (1) increasing the relative learning speed of the query-key circuit, or using a factorized Q/K parameterization, both concentrate attention more strongly on task-relevant tokens; (2) these changes barely affect training loss or downstream task metrics; (3) parameter evolution trajectories on synthetic data match the closed-form dynamics closely, validating the log(t) and log^2(t) scaling laws.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim-level read, estimated 40–60 minutes. Focus on: (1) the two-circuit decomposition and problem framing in the Introduction; (2) the core conclusions of the parameterization comparison and gradient-flow derivation in Section 3 (full mathematical detail is optional); (3) attention visualizations and quantitative metrics on real datasets in Section 5. Open directions worth pursuing: whether the findings generalize to multi-layer, multi-head, large-scale pretraining; whether grouped learning-rate scheduling can directly control attention sharpness to improve long-context behavior or interpretability.

recommendation.zh: 把 QK/OV 学习率比与注意力锐度用闭式动态连起来，是少有的干净机制分析；玩具 setup，结论需在大模型上验证，看 §3 推导即可。
recommendation.en: Cleanly links QK/OV LR ratio to attention sharpness via closed-form dynamics; toy setup—read §3 for the derivation, verify at scale yourself.

paper.title: DUD: Decoupled Update Dynamics for Reliable Uncertainty Quantification in Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Accurate Uncertainty Quantification (UQ) is critical for reliable deployment of Large Language Models (LLMs), yet traditional probability-based metrics often fail to capture the model's true epistemic state. While recent mechanistic approaches leverage hidden state dynamics, they typically aggregate residual stream updates, conflating the distinct roles of parametric memory (Feed-Forward Networks) and contextual processing (Attention). We argue that this aggregation obscures fine-grained mechani

summary.core_problem: 为 LLM uncertainty quantification 提供更细粒度的内部机制信号，避免只用输出概率或聚合 residual stream 动态来估计不确定性。
summary.importance: 贡献是机制分析和 UQ 方法。它把 Attention 的上下文处理与 FFN 的参数记忆分开看，认为二者的冲突和恢复能力能揭示模型内部脆弱性；对幻觉检测、置信度估计和训练动态分析都有间接价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Decoupled Update Dynamics (DUD)。方法通过 noise-induced causal interventions 分别干预 FFN 和 Attention 的贡献，量化两个模块各自恢复正确内部状态或输出的能力，形成 dual-stream dynamic profile，用于捕捉 memory-context misalignment 等不确定性来源。
summary.experiments: 摘要称进行了广泛实验，证明 DUD 能捕捉模型内部 fragility，并优于传统 probability-based UQ 与聚合 hidden-state dynamics 方法。具体模型规模、数据集、baseline、提升幅度和显著性需要看正文确认。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Nanjing University of Aeronautics and Astronautics、The Key Laboratory of Brain-Machine Intelligence Technology 等。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper seeks a finer-grained internal signal for LLM uncertainty quantification, beyond output probabilities or aggregated residual-stream dynamics.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a mechanistic UQ method. It separates Attention as contextual processing from FFNs as parametric memory, arguing that conflicts between the two streams reveal internal fragility. This is indirectly useful for hallucination detection, confidence estimation, and training-dynamics analysis.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors propose Decoupled Update Dynamics (DUD). It uses noise-induced causal interventions to decouple FFN and Attention contributions, measures each module's independent restoration capability, and builds a dual-stream dynamic profile that captures uncertainty sources such as memory-context misalignment.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports extensive experiments showing that DUD captures internal fragility and improves over probability-based UQ and aggregated hidden-state dynamics methods. The exact model sizes, datasets, baselines, effect sizes, and significance tests require the full paper.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are affiliated with Nanjing University of Aeronautics and Astronautics and The Key Laboratory of Brain-Machine Intelligence Technology.

recommendation.en: Skim the method and main table; the FFN/Attention split looks more transferable as a UQ signal than raw logprob.

paper.title: Attention is Case-Sensitive
paper.abstract: In human visual perception, uppercase lettering serves as a natural salience cue that captures attention within lowercase text. In this paper, we present a systematic empirical characterization study revealing that Large Language Models (LLMs) exhibit an analogous property: letter casing modulates internal attention allocation. Through analysis across 13 models, nine LLMs and four Vision-Language Models (VLMs), with diverse tokenization schemes, we show that formatting target information in alte

summary.core_problem: 字母大小写差异通常被视为tokenizer的被动附带产物，此前没有系统研究预训练Transformer（包括LLM和VLM）中是否存在类似人类视觉感知的、由大小写调节内部注意力分配的效应，以及该效应的边界条件。
summary.importance: 揭示了预训练过程中Transformer会将排版大小写内隐学习为一种潜在的注意力优先级信号，而非无关紧要的tokenization细节。这一发现有助于理解预训练数据中的表层排版特征如何塑造模型内部行为，为注意力操控、模型可解释性研究提供了新的切入角度。推理模型与非推理模型的效应差异也为理解推理过程的语义重对齐功能提供了实证依据。
summary.technical_approach: 研究采用完全训练无关的实验范式，仅在tokenization之前修改输入文本的大小写，严格保持词序和语义不变。实验设计将目标span（标注的正确答案span或对应图像区域的文本描述）设置为大写或交替大小写、周围上下文保持小写，同时设置反向干预（上下文大写、目标小写）用于因果验证。评估覆盖13个模型：9个LLM（7个非推理、2个推理）和4个VLM（2个非推理、2个推理），涵盖不同规模和tokenizer类型。测量指标包括目标span上的跨层注意力集中度变化，以及下游任务性能的变化。核心贡献是系统刻画了此前未被充分研究的“大小写显著性”效应，以及发现推理模型的审慎推理过程会过滤这类表层排版信号。
summary.experiments: 大小写显著性效应在所有被测非推理LLM中普遍存在：格式化为大写或交替大小写的目标span，跨层注意力集中度显著提升。该效应延伸到VLM场景：将文本描述中的目标词改为大写，会使图像注意力向对应视觉区域偏移。反向干预实验中，大写上下文中的小写目标注意力下降，验证了大小写变化的因果作用。注意力集中度提升并不总能改善下游性能，根据任务上下文不同可能带来提升也可能造成下降。推理模型在文本任务中的大小写效应明显减弱，因为其审慎推理过程会进行语义重对齐，优先保证逻辑一致性而非遵循表层排版信号。所有实验仅通过prompt层面的大小写修改实现，未进行微调、添加适配器或运行时模型内部探测。
summary.reading_guide: 重点阅读引言中的问题提出、方法论部分的控制变量设计（如何排除语义混淆因素），以及推理模型与非推理模型的对比结果。无需深挖数学细节，预计阅读时间20-30分钟。从事可解释性或注意力操控研究的读者可额外关注因果分析的实验设计。

summary_en.core_problem: Letter case variation is conventionally treated as a passive artifact of tokenization. There is no systematic characterization of whether typographic case modulates internal attention allocation in pretrained LLMs and VLMs — analogous to the case-based salience effect observed in human visual perception — nor of the boundary conditions of such an effect.
summary_en.importance: The findings demonstrate that pretrained transformers implicitly internalize typographic case as a latent attention priority signal during pretraining, rather than it being a trivial tokenization quirk. This informs understanding of how surface-level formatting features in pretraining data shape model internal behavior, and provides a new angle for attention steering and interpretability research. The observed difference between reasoning and non-reasoning models also offers empirical evidence for the semantic realignment function of deliberative reasoning processes.
summary_en.technical_approach: The study uses an entirely training-free experimental paradigm: it modifies only the letter case of input text before tokenization, while strictly preserving word order and semantic content. The experimental design formats target spans (ground-truth answer spans or text descriptions corresponding to image regions) in uppercase or alternating case against a lowercase context, and runs reverse interventions (uppercase context, lowercase targets) for causal validation. The evaluation covers 13 models: 9 LLMs (7 non-reasoning, 2 reasoning) and 4 VLMs (2 non-reasoning, 2 reasoning) across different scales and tokenizer types. Measured outcomes include changes in cross-layer attention concentration on target spans, as well as downstream task performance shifts. Core contributions include systematic characterization of the under-explored "casing-salience" effect, and the finding that deliberative reasoning processes in reasoning models filter out such surface-level typographic cues.
summary_en.experiments: The casing-salience effect is universal across all evaluated non-reasoning LLMs: target spans formatted in uppercase or alternating case show significantly higher cross-layer attention concentration. The effect extends to VLMs: uppercasing target words in text descriptions shifts image attention toward corresponding visual regions. Reverse intervention experiments reduce attention on lowercase targets embedded in uppercase context, confirming the causal role of case variation. Increased attention concentration does not consistently improve downstream performance — it can lead to both gains and degradations depending on task context. Reasoning models show weakened casing effects in text tasks, as their deliberative reasoning process performs semantic realignment that prioritizes logical coherence over surface typographic signals. All experiments use only prompt-level case modification, with no fine-tuning, adapters, or runtime model introspection.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the problem framing in the introduction, the controlled variable design in the methodology (how semantic confounders are excluded), and the comparison results between reasoning and non-reasoning models. No deep dive into mathematical details is needed; estimated reading time is 20–30 minutes. Researchers working on interpretability or attention steering may pay extra attention to the causal analysis experiment design.

recommendation.zh: 这篇改变的是对“格式噪声无害”的默认假设；先看 attention-performance divergence 的图。
recommendation.en: This weakens the default assumption that casing is harmless formatting noise; start with the attention-performance divergence plots.

paper.title: One QK Channel, Many Sources: Guarding Low-Precision Attention Collapse
paper.abstract: A bfloat16 transformer can train normally for many steps and then collapse abruptly. Distinct low-precision errors can trigger the same failure, leaving unclear whether each source needs its own repair or one shared route can be blocked. We isolate a reproduced GPT-2-class collapse to the streaming-softmax accumulator, where fp32 accumulation repairs it, and use the fault as an assay for moving controlled errors across sources. Errors placed outside attention still drive the same query-key (QK)

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文研究 bf16 Transformer 训练中一种棘手的失稳：训练可以长期看起来正常，但随后突然 collapse。核心问题不是“某个低精度算子是否有错”，而是不同低精度误差是否会通过同一条失败通道放大。作者用 GPT-2 small + OpenWebText 复现了 collapse，并把故障定位到 FlashAttention-2 风格 tiled online softmax recurrence 中的 streaming-softmax accumulator。更重要的是，论文进一步证明：即使误差源从 attention 内部移到 attention 外部，最终仍会进入同一个 QK spectral runaway 通道；只修 QK 路径就能阻断 collapse，而不需要逐个修复所有误差源。
summary.importance: 这篇工作的价值在于把低精度训练稳定性问题从“局部数值误差排查”推进到“失败通道识别”。对预训练研究很直接：大规模训练中常见的 loss spike、attention saturation、late-stage collapse，往往不能只靠定位某个 kernel 或某个 dtype 来解释。论文给出一个有操作性的判断：对于具有时间符号一致性的低精度误差，危险不在误差源本身，而在它们是否能沿 residual-block parameter updates 或上游路径进入 QK 子空间，并推动 attention logits 饱和。这意味着防护策略可以放在 QK locus，而不是在所有潜在低精度源头上使用 fp32。贡献量级不是新的训练 recipe，而是一个较清楚的 failure mechanism 和一个可触发的 containment controller，对低精度预训练、FlashAttention 类 kernel 验证、QK norm 使用时机都有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach:
技术路线分三步。第一步是 isolate：作者在 PyTorch 中重实现 FlashAttention-2 的 tiled online-softmax recurrence，使 running output O 和 softmax statistics carry 暴露出来，可以逐项改精度。对比 vendor kernel、full-matrix attention、bf16 operands、tiling 等因素后，作者把复现出的 GPT-2-class collapse 定位到 bf16 streaming accumulator artifact。fp32 accumulation 能修复这一特定 accumulator fault，说明 collapse 不是简单来自 bf16 输入、FlashAttention 结构或单一训练尺度。

第二步是 identify：作者设计了 controlled fault-source moves 和 always-on module-routed gradient correction。关键点是 source mechanism 仍然开启，只改变哪条模块路径收到 clean fp32 gradient。这样测的是“阻断通道”，不是“修复源头”。结果显示，来自 attention 内部和 attention 外部的误差都会汇聚到同一个 dominant QK channel；纠正 QK route 可以稳定训练，纠正 MLP route 不行。这给出了 source-channel dissociation：fault source is not failure channel。

第三步是 explain and contain：作者分析进入 QK channel 的条件，指出 temporal sign-coherence 是关键，即每个 head 的 error sign 在 optimizer steps 间持续一致。它不同于 per-tile scalar mean 或误差总能量。论文还用 equal-energy off-target control 和移除每个 run 自身 dominant QK weight directions 的实验，说明 QK channel 是早期 runaway 的驱动因素，不只是 collapse 的观测指标。最后提出 QK-Guard：平时不改变模型；在线监控 attention-logit saturation；当检测到 runaway 正在发展时，在 QK locus 启用 parameter-free per-head QK normalization。它不回滚训练，也不修复原始 fault，而是阻断下游通道。对照实验显示，同一触发时刻做 softmax-local action 或 learning-rate cut 不能救回训练，说明 action locus 比“是否响应及时”更关键。
summary.experiments:
实验围绕 GPT-2 small 在 OpenWebText 上的 bf16 训练 collapse 展开。作者报告 baseline 在观察窗口内各 seed 都 collapse，而 fp32 accumulation 相关条件没有观察到 collapse：包括 accumulator → fp32 的两个 seed、fp32/fp32 carry 的两个 seed，以及一个手动停止时仍健康的长 run，记录到 103400 logged steps。这里作者没有把它当 collapse-rate 估计，而是作为 sufficiency counterexample：在原 baseline 必崩的窗口内，单因素 fp32 accumulation 可以阻断该 fault。

定位实验区分了 streaming carry 的两类路径。running output O 在 backward 中通过 D-term 影响 score gradient，进而影响 dQ 和 dK，但不直接影响 dV；statistics carry 通过 saved log normalizer 重标定 recomputed probabilities P，会影响 dQ、dK 和 dV。论文借此解释为什么某些 carry precision 会表现为 QK 相关错误，而不是平均地污染所有 attention 参数。

识别实验把 fault 移动到 attention 外部，仍观察到同样的 QK spectral runaway；然后用 module-routed clean gradient 做通道阻断。结果是 QK route correction 能稳定训练，MLP route correction 不能。这是最关键的因果证据。

机制实验操纵 error-sign sequences，分离 temporal sign-coherence、per-tile scalar mean 和 aggregate magnitude。只有具有跨 step 符号持续性的误差更容易进入 QK channel。作者也指出它不能直接作为在线触发信号，因为正常 feature learning 也会有时间一致性。QK-Guard 因此选择监控 attention-logit saturation。触发后，per-head QK normalization 能 contain runaway；同一时刻的 softmax-local 处理和 learning-rate cut 失败，支持“必须在 QK locus 动作”的结论。
summary.reading_guide:
建议精读 Introduction 的 contribution framing，因为它把 source、channel、trigger、action locus 四个概念分得很清楚。§2 是最值得看的实验设计部分，尤其是 Table 1 附近关于 FlashAttention-2 online-softmax recurrence、running output O、softmax statistics carry、fp32 accumulation 对照的内容。这部分决定了论文的可信度。

§3 需要重点看 module-routed gradient correction 的 assay。判断这篇论文是否站得住，主要看它是否真的在 source mechanism 保持开启时只阻断某条 route。如果这个实验成立，结论就比“某个 kernel 用 fp32 就好”强很多。

§4 建议看 temporal sign-coherence 的操纵实验，以及 equal-energy off-target control 和 dominant QK weight directions removal。这里回答两个问题：什么样的误差会进 QK channel；QK runaway 是因还是果。

§5 看 QK-Guard 的 sensing/action 分离。重点不是 QK norm 本身，而是触发条件为什么选 attention-logit saturation，以及为什么 softmax-local action 和 learning-rate cut 失败。对做大规模低精度训练的人，最可复用的是这种在线诊断与局部 containment 的设计方式。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies a late-collapse failure mode in bf16 Transformer training: a run can look healthy for many optimization steps and then fail abruptly. The key question is whether each low-precision fault must be fixed at its own source, or whether heterogeneous faults enter a shared failure channel. Using a GPT-2 small collapse on OpenWebText, the authors localize one reproducible fault to the streaming-softmax accumulator in a FlashAttention-2-style tiled online softmax recurrence. They then use this fault as an assay and show that errors originating both inside and outside attention converge to the same QK spectral runaway. Correcting the QK route blocks the collapse while leaving the fault active.
summary_en.importance: The main contribution is a clean separation between numerical fault sources and the channel that turns them into training failure. This is directly relevant to low-precision pretraining: loss spikes and sudden collapses are often debugged as local kernel or dtype bugs, but this paper shows that the dangerous part can be a shared QK route rather than the original error site. The practical implication is also clear. For temporally sign-coherent low-precision errors that perturb residual-block parameter updates, acting at the QK locus may be sufficient, whereas making every possible source fp32 is neither targeted nor scalable. The work gives a useful mechanism for interpreting attention saturation, QK normalization, and precision choices in large-scale training.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The paper follows an isolate-identify-explain-contain structure. First, the authors reproduce a GPT-2-class collapse in a PyTorch implementation of FlashAttention-2's tiled online-softmax recurrence. This implementation exposes the running output O and the softmax statistics carry, which allows controlled precision edits. The decisive intervention is fp32 accumulation in the streaming accumulator: it prevents the reproduced collapse while preserving the tiled computation. This rules out several simpler explanations, including bf16 operands, tiling itself, the FlashAttention family as a whole, or a single-scale artifact.

Second, the authors introduce an identification assay based on controlled fault-source moves and always-on module-routed gradient correction. The source mechanism remains enabled, while clean fp32 gradients are routed through selected modules. This tests channel blocking rather than source repair. The result is the central source-channel dissociation: faults placed inside attention and faults placed outside attention both drive the same dominant QK channel; QK-route correction stabilizes training, while MLP-route correction does not.

Third, the paper explains how errors enter the QK channel. The distinguishing property is temporal sign-coherence: the error sign for a head persists across optimizer steps. This is separated from per-tile scalar mean and total error magnitude. The authors also test causality with equal-energy off-target controls and by removing each run's own dominant QK weight directions, showing that the QK channel drives the early runaway rather than merely tracking it.

Finally, the paper proposes QK-Guard, a dormant containment controller. It monitors attention-logit saturation and, once a runaway is developing, applies parameter-free per-head QK normalization at the QK locus. It does not repair the underlying fault or rewind the run. At the same trigger point, a softmax-local intervention and a learning-rate cut fail, indicating that the rescue depends on where the action is applied.
summary_en.experiments:
The empirical base is a bf16 GPT-2 small training setup on OpenWebText. The baseline collapses in every seed within the observed window. In contrast, fp32-accumulation variants do not collapse in the reported runs: two seeds for the accumulator-to-fp32 arm, two seeds for the fp32/fp32 carry condition, and one long run that was manually stopped while still healthy at 103400 logged steps. The paper treats these as sufficiency counterexamples, not as collapse-rate estimates.

The accumulator analysis separates the backward paths of the streaming carries. The running output O re-enters backward through the D-term, perturbing the score gradient and therefore dQ and dK, but not dV. The statistics carry affects recomputed probabilities through the saved log normalizer and can affect dQ, dK, and dV. This explains why a carry-precision fault can show up as a QK-driven instability rather than as uniform attention-parameter noise.

The channel-identification experiments move the fault outside attention and still observe the same QK spectral runaway. With module-routed clean gradients, QK correction blocks the collapse while MLP correction does not. The mechanism experiments manipulate error-sign sequences and show that temporal sign-coherence, rather than scalar mean or aggregate energy, predicts entry into the QK channel. QK-Guard then uses attention-logit saturation as the online signal, because temporal coherence alone is not specific to failure; normal feature learning can also be temporally coherent.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Read the introduction carefully for the distinction between fault source, failure channel, trigger signal, and action locus. Section 2 is the most important part for assessing the numerical claim: focus on the FlashAttention-2 online-softmax recurrence, the exposed carries, the fp32 accumulation contrasts, and Table 1. The credibility of the paper depends on whether the reproduced collapse is truly localized to the streaming accumulator without changing other factors.

Section 3 is the key mechanism section. The module-routed gradient correction assay is the central experiment: the fault remains active, but only one route receives a clean gradient. This is what makes the QK-channel conclusion stronger than a standard kernel fix.

Section 4 is worth reading for the temporal sign-coherence manipulations and the causal controls around dominant QK directions. These experiments explain why some low-precision errors become dangerous and why QK spectral growth should be treated as a driver, not only as a symptom.

Section 5 is useful for practitioners. The important design choice is the separation of sensing from action: monitor attention-logit saturation, then apply per-head QK normalization only when needed. The failed softmax-local and learning-rate-cut controls are particularly informative.

recommendation.zh: 应立刻复现实验里的 QK 谱监控；它改变调试习惯：别只追 fault source，先保护 failure channel。
recommendation.en: Replicate the QK spectral monitors; the useful shift is to protect the failure channel, not only chase the numerical fault source.

paper.title: Role-Decoupled Attention Residuals: Separating Matching and Content Retrieval Across Depth
paper.abstract: Depth-routing residual architectures allow Transformer layers to retrieve earlier representations instead of inheriting only the immediately preceding state. Existing Block Attention Residuals, however, use a single content-dependent depth mixture to construct the inputs to queries, keys, and values. This design couples two functionally different decisions: queries and keys determine where attention matches, whereas values determine what content is retrieved. We therefore ask whether matching an

summary.core_problem: Block Attention Residuals 这类深度路由架构中，每一层用同一个内容相关的深度混合结果作为 Q、K、V 的共同输入。这把注意力的两个功能绑在了一起：Q/K 决定「在哪里匹配」，V 决定「取回什么内容」。论文要验证的是：把 V 的深度路由独立出来，是否能在几乎不增加计算量的前提下提升预训练效果。
summary.importance: 这是对深度路由 Transformer 架构的一个最小化但有明确功能含义的修正。它指出 Block AttnRes 中共享 QKV 深度读取不是无害的实现细节，而是一个有实际影响的约束。对关注 Transformer 残差流设计、深度路由、注意力功能拆分的研究有直接参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Role-Decoupled Attention Residuals（RD-AttnRes）：Q 和 K 共享一个深度路由混合结果，V 则使用独立的深度路由，两者作用在完全相同的源集合上。MLP 侧的路由、残差源构造、写回方式都保持不变。当 V 的路由查询与 QK 的路由查询绑定时，RD-AttnRes 精确退化为 Block AttnRes，因此是严格的超集扩展。新增参数只有每层一个 d 维的 value route query，参数量增加不到 0.01%。额外计算量是 O(BTKd) 级别的源混合，不增加 O(BT²d) 的 token-to-token 注意力运算。
summary.experiments: 在 FineWeb-Edu 10BT 样本上训练 120M 和 343M 两个规模的模型，各 5 个配对种子，训练 20 亿 token。在所有种子、所有评估里程碑上，RD-AttnRes 的验证 NLL 都低于 Block AttnRes 基线，效果在训练前期更明显，后期绝对值收窄。对照实验表明，单纯增加参数或执行两遍路由并不能复现提升；学到的 QK 路由分布和 V 路由分布确实不相同，支持「匹配几何与内容检索应当解耦」的解释。论文也明确说明没有验证更大规模的缩放行为，也没有和所有深度路由架构做对比。
summary.reading_guide: 重点读第 2 节方法部分的公式推导和退化性证明，理解为什么这是一个严格超集扩展。第 4–5 节的配对实验设计和路由诊断图值得细看，特别是 QK 与 V 路由分布差异的可视化。第 6 节的运行时开销数据也可以快速过一下。预计阅读时间 30–45 分钟。
summary.authors_note: Kimi Team 相关工作（Block AttnRes 原团队延伸）

summary_en.core_problem: In depth-routing architectures like Block Attention Residuals, each layer uses a single content-dependent depth mixture as the shared input to queries, keys, and values. This couples two functionally distinct roles of attention: Q/K determine where attention matches, while V determines what content is retrieved. The paper tests whether giving V its own depth route improves pretraining under a minimal, auditable modification.
summary_en.importance: This is a minimal but functionally meaningful correction to depth-routed Transformer design. It shows that the shared QKV depth read in Block AttnRes is not an innocuous implementation detail but a consequential constraint. The work is directly relevant to research on Transformer residual-stream design, depth routing, and the functional decomposition of attention.
summary_en.technical_approach: Role-Decoupled Attention Residuals (RD-AttnRes) keeps one depth mixture shared between queries and keys, while giving values an independent depth route over exactly the same source set. The MLP-side route, residual source construction, and writeback all remain unchanged. When the value route query is tied to the QK route query, RD-AttnRes exactly recovers Block AttnRes — making it a strict superset extension. The only new parameters are one d-dimensional value route query per layer, adding less than 0.01% parameters. The extra computation is O(BTKd) for the second source mixture, with no additional O(BT²d) token-to-token attention cost.
summary_en.experiments: Models of 120M and 343M parameters are trained on the FineWeb-Edu 10BT sample for 2.0B tokens, with 5 paired seeds each. RD-AttnRes achieves lower validation NLL than Block AttnRes on every seed and at every evaluation milestone; the effect is larger early in training and narrows in absolute magnitude later. Controls show that simply adding parameters or running two routes does not reproduce the gain, and the learned QK and V route distributions do not collapse to the same solution — consistent with the proposed decoupling explanation. The paper explicitly does not claim universal scaling behavior or superiority to all depth-routing architectures.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section 2 for the method derivation and the exact-recovery argument showing RD-AttnRes is a strict superset. Sections 4–5 contain the paired experimental design and route diagnostics; the visualization of diverging QK vs V distributions is particularly worth examining. Section 6 on runtime overhead can be skimmed. Estimated reading time: 30–45 minutes.
summary_en.authors_note: Extension of the Kimi Team Block AttnRes work

recommendation.zh: 这是那种值得架构组做一轮小型 ablation 的 paper：想法干净、改动便宜，但先别改 prior，得看它是否只在特定 depth-routing setup 下成立。
recommendation.en: This is the kind of paper worth a small internal ablation: the idea is clean and cheap, but don’t update your prior until you see whether it only works in a narrow depth-routing setup.

paper.title: TPD: Temporal Prior Decoupling for Text-to-Video Diffusion Models
paper.abstract: Text-to-video diffusion models generate temporally coherent content from natural language, yet when a prompt describes an early scene that persists while a new event emerges on top of it---such as "a tall sandcastle standing on a beach where a wave rushes in and washes it away"---generation frequently fails to realize the late-segment event in the corresponding frames. We identify this failure as Temporal Prior Suppression (TPS): the dominant prior of the early segment captures the cross-attenti

summary.core_problem: 解决文本到视频扩散模型在“早期场景持续存在、后期事件叠加发生”这类 prompt 中，经常无法生成后段事件的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献是对视频扩散采样失败模式的分析和 training-free 修正。它提出 Temporal Prior Suppression 这一诊断：早期片段的强先验会沿时间轴占据 cross-attention 轨迹，压制后期事件的 guidance 信号。对 LLM 预训练的直接相关性不高，但对长程条件生成和注意力轨迹分析有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Temporal Prior Decoupling。方法在采样时构造只包含早期片段条件的 temporal counterfactual，把完整 prompt 与 counterfactual 的去噪轨迹差异视为被压制的后期事件信号，再用该差异恢复 late-segment guidance。方法不训练新模型，主要改动扩散采样过程。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出使用的 T2V 基础模型、评测集、基线或具体提升幅度。实验应针对包含时间转折、后段事件和持续场景的复杂视频 prompt。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 University of Maryland at College Park。

summary_en.core_problem: Fix a failure mode in text-to-video diffusion models where prompts with a persistent early scene and a later emerging event often fail to realize the late event.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an analysis of a video diffusion sampling failure mode plus a training-free correction. It names the failure Temporal Prior Suppression: a dominant early-segment prior captures the cross-attention trajectory over time and suppresses the guidance signal for late events. It is not central to LLM pretraining, but it is relevant to long-horizon conditional generation and attention-trajectory analysis.
summary_en.technical_approach: Temporal Prior Decoupling constructs a temporal counterfactual conditioned only on the early segment. The discrepancy between the full-prompt and counterfactual denoising trajectories is treated as the suppressed late-segment signal, which is then used to restore guidance during sampling. The method changes inference rather than training a new model.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not specify the base T2V model, benchmark, baselines, or quantitative gains. The experiments likely focus on complex video prompts with temporal transitions, late events, and persistent early scenes.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from the University of Maryland at College Park.

recommendation.zh: Temporal Prior Suppression 这个失败模式值得记；正文只看问题定义和 counterfactual guidance，指标可先放低权重。
recommendation.en: The Temporal Prior Suppression failure mode is worth noting; read the problem definition and counterfactual guidance, but treat the metrics lightly.

institutions: University of Maryland at College Park

paper.title: Focus Is All You Need: Adaptive Goal-aware Attention Orchestration for Multi-Agent Graph Systems
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) enable autonomous agents for reasoning, planning, and tool use. Recent systems increasingly organize these agents as graphs of specialized, interconnected nodes. Although graph-based orchestration supports flexible decomposition and coordination, it creates a key challenge: \textbf{attention allocation}. As workflows grow, existing approaches often execute graph components uniformly, wasting resources on irrelevant or low-impact tasks. We introduce \textbf{Attention

summary.core_problem: 解决图结构多 Agent 系统中所有节点近似均匀执行导致的算力浪费和任务相关性不足问题。
summary.importance: 贡献是通用 Agent 编排方法，尝试把 Transformer attention 的资源分配直觉迁移到 workflow-level Agent 协作；它不是模型架构预训练意义上的 attention 改进。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Adaptive Goal-aware Attention Orchestration。框架用 goal-aware attention 衡量用户目标与 Agent 能力的语义相关性，用 topology-aware attention 建模图依赖关系，并结合计算约束动态估计各 Agent 节点重要性，从而选择或加权执行更相关的工作流组件。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体 benchmark、模型规模、baseline 或提升幅度；需要看正文是否有真实多 Agent 任务和成本-质量曲线，否则容易停留在编排层隐喻。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets resource waste in graph-based multi-agent systems, where many workflow components are executed uniformly even when they are weakly related to the current goal.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a general agent-orchestration method. It transfers the intuition of attention-based allocation from token representations to workflow-level coordination, but it is not an attention architecture contribution for pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: Adaptive Goal-aware Attention Orchestration estimates agent-node importance using user goals, graph dependencies, and compute constraints. It combines goal-aware attention over semantic relevance, topology-aware attention over graph structure, and resource-aware selection or weighting of workflow components.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report specific benchmarks, model scales, baselines, or gains. The key question is whether the paper shows real cost-quality tradeoffs on nontrivial multi-agent tasks, rather than only an orchestration metaphor.

recommendation.zh: 概念像样但容易是 workflow attention 类比；只看实验表和成本曲线是否真的省调用。
recommendation.en: The idea is plausible but may be mostly a workflow-attention analogy; check only the experiments and cost-quality curves.

paper.title: HiKV: Hierarchical Importance-Aware KV Cache with Hardware Acceleration for LLM Decoding
paper.abstract: With the rapid adoption of long-context large language models (LLMs), the continuously growing KV cache during decoding has become the critical memory bottleneck. To tackle this challenge, we propose HiKV, a novel algorithm-hardware co-design that exploits KV cache redundancy through hierarchical importance awareness. Algorithmically, HiKV compresses the KV cache at two granularities: Stage I evicts unimportant tokens within a fixed budget, and Stage II further loads only the significant element

summary.core_problem: 长上下文LLM解码阶段KV缓存随序列长度和batch规模线性增长，成为核心内存瓶颈；现有基于重要性的KV压缩仅在token粒度做驱逐，保留token的完整KV向量仍存在元素级冗余，且动态排序的计算开销大，缺乏算法与硬件的协同优化。
summary.importance: 算法-硬件协同设计的思路可延伸到长序列预训练的注意力内存优化场景；两级粒度的冗余消除模式为理解注意力稀疏性结构提供了实证依据，可为预训练中的稀疏注意力设计提供参考。
summary.technical_approach: 提出分层重要性感知的KV缓存压缩与硬件加速协同方案。算法分为两阶段：第一阶段在固定缓存预算内，基于累积注意力得分动态驱逐不重要的token；第二阶段对保留的token，仅加载对注意力计算影响显著的向量元素，实现单粒度方法无法达到的压缩比。硬件上设计专用加速器，核心是可重构重要性排序器，可在第一阶段的堆式重要性维护和第二阶段的并行分块排序两种数据通路间切换，统一两阶段加速需求，仅增加8%的系统级面积开销。
summary.experiments: 在长上下文基准测试中，相比token级最优方法，在精度损失不超过1%的约束下压缩比更优；相比原始基线，解码阶段注意力计算最高获得7.95倍加速，能耗降低90%，在等精度约束下性能优于现有KV缓存优化方案。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议：重点关注第III节的两级压缩算法设计思路和第V节的系统级性能对比，可跳过硬件电路实现细节；预计阅读时间15-20分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: KV cache grows linearly with sequence length and batch size during long-context LLM decoding, becoming the dominant memory bottleneck. Existing importance-based KV compression only operates at token granularity, leaving element-level redundancy in full KV vectors of retained tokens, and the high overhead of dynamic sorting lacks algorithm-hardware co-optimization.
summary_en.importance: The algorithm-hardware co-design principle can be extended to attention memory optimization in long-sequence pretraining. The two-level redundancy elimination pattern provides empirical evidence for understanding attention sparsity structure, which can inform sparse attention design in pretraining pipelines.
summary_en.technical_approach: HiKV is a hierarchical importance-aware KV cache compression framework with dedicated hardware acceleration. Algorithmically, it runs two complementary stages: Stage I dynamically evicts unimportant tokens within a fixed cache budget based on accumulated attention scores; Stage II selectively loads only significant vector elements from retained tokens, achieving compression ratios unattainable by single-granularity methods. Architecturally, a custom accelerator with a reconfigurable importance sorter switches between heap-based importance maintenance (Stage I) and parallel chunk-based sorting (Stage II), unifying two-stage acceleration with only 8% system-level area overhead.
summary_en.experiments: On long-context benchmarks, HiKV achieves better compression ratios than leading token-level methods under 1% accuracy loss. Compared to the vanilla baseline, it delivers up to 7.95× speedup and 90% energy reduction in attention computation during decoding, outperforming existing KV cache optimizations under iso-accuracy constraints.
summary_en.reading_guide: For skimming: focus on Section III for the two-stage compression algorithm design and Section V for system-level performance comparison; skip hardware circuit implementation details. Estimated reading time: 15-20 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 做长上下文 serving 的可以看；对 pretrain 本身帮助有限，但“token 级+元素级”双层压缩这个归纳值得记，先看方法图和质量退化表再决定是否深读。
recommendation.en: Worth a skim if you care about long-context serving; limited pretrain impact, but the token-level plus element-level compression decomposition is a useful design pattern—check the method figure and quality-retention tables first.

paper.title: Visual Saliency Steering Distillation for Multimodal Chain-of-Thought Reasoning
paper.abstract: Multimodal chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning integrates visual and textual cues through step-by-step inference. In small models with limited token budgets, modality-interaction fusion often suppresses tiny cross-modal differences. In particular, multimodal CoT often struggles when different images pair with identical text or different texts pair with an identical image, making such inputs nearly indistinguishable after fusion. This study proposes Visual Saliency Steering Distillation (VSSD). VSSD

summary.core_problem: 小模型做多模态 CoT 时，视觉-文本融合会抹平细粒度差异，导致“同文不同图/同图不同文”输入在融合后难以区分，从而推理与rationale退化。
summary.importance: 属于多模态蒸馏/对齐信号设计：尝试把大模型的注意力显著性转成可用于小模型训练的“方向性监督”，对做小模型多模态推理压缩有一定参考价值，但与基座预训练主线关联偏弱。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 VSSD：用多模态大模型的 attention map 生成任务敏感的图像扰动（沿显著区域/方向），再对扰动引起的特征变化做 SVD 提取主导 steering vectors，用这些向量做跨层(inter-layer)蒸馏以增强小模型的跨模态差异感知与推理链生成。
summary.experiments: 在 ScienceQA 与 M^3CoT 上评估，报告对 rationale 生成与答案推断的提升；摘要未给出模型规模、蒸馏teacher具体型号、提升幅度与关键消融细节（如仅用attention扰动 vs 仅SVD向量 vs 常规logit/feature distill）。

summary_en.core_problem: Small multimodal models with tight token budgets tend to wash out fine-grained cross-modal differences after fusion, making “same text/different images” (or vice versa) hard to distinguish and hurting multimodal CoT reasoning.
summary_en.importance: A multimodal distillation signal design that converts LMM attention saliency into directional supervision for student models; potentially useful for compressing multimodal reasoning, but only loosely connected to core foundation pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: VSSD: use a teacher LMM’s attention maps to create task-sensitive image perturbations, apply SVD on the induced feature variations to extract dominant steering vectors, and use them for inter-layer distillation to better preserve cross-modal discriminative cues.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on ScienceQA and M^3CoT with improvements in rationale generation and answer inference; the abstract does not specify model sizes, teacher choice, gains, or key ablations (attention perturbation vs SVD vectors vs standard distillation).

recommendation.zh: 当作“用 teacher attention 造蒸馏方向信号”的小技巧备查即可；更像蒸馏工程，缺少对预训练/表征学习的干净因果消融。
recommendation.en: Worth a quick look as an attention-to-direction distillation trick; it reads more like distillation engineering with limited clean causal ablations for pretraining/representation learning.

paper.title: Dropping the Anchor: Statistical Context Summarization for Distributed Systems via Pulsar Attention
paper.abstract: Inference with large language models (LLMs) on long sequences is computationally expensive due to the quadratic complexity of self-attention. Distributed blockwise methods such as Star Attention reduce this cost by sharding context across hosts, but rely on prepending a static, content-blind copy of the first block to every host. We propose Pulsar Attention, which replaces the static anchor with two lightweight, content-aware components: a small attention-sink prefix that stabilizes softmax, and

summary.core_problem: 长上下文推理中的分布式块式注意力通常依赖静态首块锚点，既内容盲又浪费算力；这篇工作要在不增加 KV cache 的前提下改进跨块摘要与稳定性。
summary.importance: 这是推理效率方向的结构改进。价值不在于提出全新主干架构，而在于指出 blockwise long-context attention 里“固定 anchor”这个设计并不必要，内容感知摘要可以同时带来更低 FLOPs 和更好精度。对做长上下文 serving、分布式注意力和 attention sink 机制的人有直接参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Pulsar Attention，用两个轻量组件替代 Star Attention 的静态 anchor：一是小型 attention-sink prefix，用来稳定 softmax；二是基于 Max-IDF 启发式的紧凑 cross-block summaries，优先选择包含全局稀有 token 的 chunk 作为跨块代表。这样在保持相同 KV cache footprint 的同时，减少 Phase 1 的每 GPU FLOPs。
summary.experiments: 在 Llama-3.1-8B 上，于 RULER 和 BABILong 做最长 128K token 的评测。相对 Star Attention，Phase 1 per-GPU FLOPs 最多下降 3.3×；相对 dense attention 和 Star Attention，在长序列上都有更好结果，摘要称对 dense baseline 的绝对提升最高可达 4.7%。实验聚焦推理阶段，没有训练侧分析。

summary_en.core_problem: Distributed blockwise attention for long-context inference often relies on a static first-block anchor that is content-blind and compute-inefficient; this paper tries to improve cross-block summarization and stability without increasing KV cache.
summary_en.importance: This is an inference-efficiency paper with a structural tweak. The value is not a new backbone, but the argument that the fixed anchor in blockwise long-context attention is unnecessary: content-aware summaries can reduce FLOPs while improving accuracy. It is directly relevant to long-context serving, distributed attention, and attention-sink design.
summary_en.technical_approach: Pulsar Attention replaces the static anchor in Star Attention with two lightweight components: a small attention-sink prefix to stabilize softmax, and compact cross-block summaries built with a Max-IDF heuristic that selects chunks containing globally rare tokens. This keeps the KV-cache footprint unchanged while reducing per-GPU Phase-1 FLOPs.
summary_en.experiments: Using Llama-3.1-8B on RULER and BABILong up to 128K tokens, the method reports up to 3.3× lower Phase-1 per-GPU FLOPs than Star Attention. It also outperforms both Star Attention and dense attention on long-sequence evaluations, with up to 4.7% absolute gains over the dense baseline. The study is inference-only and does not analyze training-time effects.

recommendation.zh: 不是范式级工作，但它把“首块静态锚点”这个默认设计拆掉了；若你做长上下文 serving，只看方法图和 RULER/BABILong 表就够。
recommendation.en: Not a paradigm shift, but it usefully challenges the default static-anchor design in blockwise attention; for long-context serving, the method figure and the RULER/BABILong tables are enough.

paper.title: Convolution for Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) largely rely on Transformers, where self-attention provides global token interaction but does not explicitly encode the locality of natural language. We study whether lightweight depthwise convolutions can supply this local inductive bias without materially increasing model size. Our macro-level ablation compares convolution at 17 locations in a Qwen3 Transformer block and finds the best results when convolution is applied to the projected queries, keys, and values b

summary.core_problem: 研究在 Transformer LLM 中加入极轻量 depthwise convolution，是否能补足自然语言局部结构建模，而几乎不增加参数量。
summary.importance: 贡献是架构消融和局部归纳偏置分析。论文不是简单把卷积塞进模型，而是在 Qwen3 block 的 17 个插入位置做宏观消融，并给出一个低参数、易复现的 QKV 前卷积设计；对内部架构 ablation 有直接参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 方法是在 attention 之前，对投影后的 query、key、value 加 residual depthwise convolution。微观设计选择 kernel size k=3，不额外加入 normalization 或 activation，新增参数少于 0.01%。作者还做 representation-level case study，观察重复 token ID 在局部上下文下的表示敏感性变化。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖多个 Qwen3 模型和若干预训练数据预算，在 7 个下游 benchmark 的平均准确率上优于原始 Transformer 配置。摘要未给出具体模型尺寸、token 数、单项提升幅度和训练成本，但强调 17 个 block 位置的系统消融以及跨数据预算一致收益。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Peking University 和 Tsinghua University。团队成员包括 Yu Wang、Yunhe Wang 等，相关团队长期做高效模型、模型压缩和架构设计。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies whether a very small depthwise convolution can add useful local inductive bias to Transformer LLMs without materially increasing parameter count.
summary_en.importance: Its main contribution is an architecture ablation rather than a generic convolution add-on. It compares 17 insertion points inside a Qwen3 Transformer block and identifies a lightweight QKV-side design that is easy to reproduce in internal architecture sweeps.
summary_en.technical_approach: The proposed design applies residual depthwise convolution to the projected queries, keys, and values before attention. The preferred micro-design uses kernel size 3, with no extra normalization or activation, adding less than 0.01% parameters. A representation-level case study examines how repeated token IDs become more sensitive to immediate context.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments span Qwen3 models and several pretraining data budgets. The proposed variant improves average accuracy across seven downstream benchmarks over the baseline Transformer. The abstract does not report exact model sizes, token counts, per-task gains, or training cost, but highlights the 17-location ablation and consistent gains across budgets.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from Peking University and Tsinghua University. Yu Wang and Yunhe Wang are associated with prior work on efficient models, compression, and architecture design.

recommendation.zh: 值得看 17 个插入点消融；若结果可复现，QKV 前 k=3 depthwise conv 应进入内部小模型预训练 sweep。
recommendation.en: Read the 17-site ablation; if it reproduces, k=3 depthwise conv before QKV should enter internal small-model pretraining sweeps.

paper.title: Breaking Feedback-Blindness: Utility-Augmented Transformer for Sequential Decision Making
paper.abstract: Sequential decision making in non-stationary and partially observable environments requires rapid adaptation to latent regime changes. However, existing Transformer decision models face a structural bottleneck in the retrieval mechanism: even when reward is used for training or exposed as an input token, attention retrieval remains primarily driven by observation-derived similarity. We formalize this limitation as feedback-blind retrieval, and formally show that, on feedback-informative tasks, o

summary.core_problem: 研究序列决策 Transformer 在非平稳、部分可观测环境中，为什么即使输入奖励信息也可能无法根据反馈改变检索到的历史上下文。
summary.importance: 贡献是提出 feedback-blind retrieval 这一结构性失败模式，并给出一个反馈调制的注意力架构。它不是 LLM 预训练论文，但对思考“注意力检索由什么信号控制”有一定机制参考。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Utility-Augmented Transformer。方法维护一个紧凑 utility state，并用它调制 query、key、value 投影，使 action-reward history 能在前向传播时直接改变上下文检索，而不是只把奖励当作普通 token 或训练监督信号。
summary.experiments: 摘要主要强调形式化证明：在 feedback-informative tasks 中，observation-equivalent 但 action-reward 结果不同的历史无法被 observation-only attention 区分。摘要未给出模型规模、任务套件、baseline 或数值提升；实验可信度需要读正文确认。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies why Transformer decision models may fail to adapt retrieval to feedback in non-stationary and partially observable environments, even when reward information is available.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution is the definition of feedback-blind retrieval as a structural failure mode and a feedback-conditioned attention architecture. It is not an LLM pretraining paper, but it is mildly useful for thinking about what signals actually control attention retrieval.
summary_en.technical_approach: It proposes the Utility-Augmented Transformer. A compact utility state modulates the query, key, and value projections so that action-reward history can directly alter context retrieval during the forward pass, instead of treating rewards merely as tokens or training signals.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract emphasizes a formal result: in feedback-informative tasks, observation-equivalent histories with different action-reward outcomes cannot be distinguished by observation-only attention. It does not report model sizes, task suites, baselines, or numerical gains, so the empirical strength needs to be checked in the full paper.

recommendation.zh: 记住 feedback-blind retrieval 这个 failure mode 即可；若实验只在小决策任务上，别外推到 LLM attention。
recommendation.en: Keep the feedback-blind retrieval failure mode in mind; if the evidence is only small decision tasks, do not overgeneralize it to LLM attention.

paper.title: Relative Positions Generalize, Absolute Positions Memorize: An Implicit-Bias Account of Length Generalization in Attention
paper.abstract: Transformers with relative positional encodings often extrapolate to sequences longer than those seen during training, whereas transformers with learned absolute encodings typically do not. This is a robust empirical regularity, and the explanations offered for it so far are chiefly about expressivity, that is, about whether a length-generalizing solution exists. We give an optimization explanation. On a minimal fixed-offset retrieval task that isolates positional selection, the gap is governed

summary.core_problem: 相对位置编码（如RoPE）比学习式绝对位置编码（APE）长度泛化能力更强是一个被广泛验证的经验规律，但现有解释均从表达能力出发，即论证能泛化的解是否存在，没有回答梯度下降为什么会在诸多可拟合短训练序列的解中，选择出可以长度泛化的解。
summary.importance: 将位置编码长度泛化的解释从表达能力层面推进到优化隐式偏置层面，回答了长期存在的位置编码外推机制问题，给出了可严格证明的分析框架，对长上下文预训练、新型位置编码设计有直接的指导意义。
summary.technical_approach: 采用最小化的固定偏移检索任务（训练仅用短序列，要求模型根据序列最后一个位置的查询，预测其前方固定偏移K位置的token），该任务剥离了其他干扰因素，仅隔离出纯位置选择能力，结合注意力训练收敛到最大间隔解的隐式偏置理论，可分别推导两类位置编码训练所得解的结构：1. 证明RoPE的注意力logit严格仅与查询和键的相对偏移有关，具备精确的等变性，训练得到的查询、键表示会形成一个与目标偏移对齐的主方向，注意力核在目标相对偏移处形成峰值，天然具备跨长度泛化性；2. 解释RoPE外推精度随序列长度增长线性下降的原因是softmax归一化的稀释效应：上下文长度增加时，目标位置的注意力权重会被其他位置摊薄；去掉softmax归一化的线性注意力虽然可以拟合训练分布，但学到的是最小范数插值解，不具备外推能力；3. 证明APE训练收敛到的解会绑定训练区间内的绝对位置，一旦超出训练长度范围就无法命中目标位置，因此泛化性崩溃。
summary.experiments: 在单层单头无MLP的最小设定下，训练长度范围为12以内，序列长度增长到48时，RoPE的准确率仍有0.83，APE在训练长度范围内准确率为1.0，超出长度后直接掉到接近随机水平（0.07，随机基线为0.05）。在两层四头带MLP、LayerNorm的完整Transformer结构上，在全序列移位任务中复现了一致的结论：RoPE在分布外仍保持偏移等变性，目标方向对齐度达0.98，而APE的对齐度仅为0.02。针对softmax的消融实验验证，去掉归一化后的线性注意力确实无法泛化，符合理论推导。
summary.reading_guide: 建议精读，重点关注第3-4节的理论证明（RoPE等变性引理、目标对齐载体引理、APE位置绑定命题）、Figure2中两类位置编码训练得到的注意力核形状对比、第7节关于softmax归一化对外推能力影响的反直觉实验。可进一步深挖的方向包括：该隐式偏置结论是否适用于ALiBi、XPos等其他相对位置编码，如何通过调整注意力归一化方式缓解softmax稀释带来的外推精度损失，以及该结论对长上下文预训练位置编码选择的具体指导。预计阅读时间45分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: The empirical finding that transformers with relative positional encodings (e.g. RoPE) extrapolate far better to unseen long sequences than those with learned absolute positional encodings (APE) is well-documented, but existing explanations focus exclusively on expressivity—whether a length-generalizing solution exists—rather than the optimization question of why gradient descent selects such a generalizable solution among all parameters that fit short training sequences.
summary_en.importance: This work moves the explanation of positional encoding length generalization beyond expressivity to the implicit bias of optimization, providing a provable, mechanistic account of a long-standing open question in transformer design. The framework delivers direct guidance for long-context pretraining and new positional encoding development.
summary_en.technical_approach: The analysis uses a minimal fixed-offset retrieval task that isolates pure positional selection, with models trained on short sequences and asked to copy a token a fixed number of positions before the final query position. Building on the existing result that trained attention heads converge to max-margin solutions under gradient descent, the structure of solutions learned with each positional encoding type can be formally derived: 1. RoPE attention logits are proven to be exactly equivariant to relative offset, independent of absolute sequence length. Trained query and key representations develop a dominant direction aligned to the target offset, producing an attention kernel peaked at the correct relative distance that generalizes across lengths. 2. The graceful accuracy decay of RoPE at longer lengths is shown to come from softmax normalization dilution: as context grows, the target token's attention weight is spread across more distractor positions. Linear attention without softmax normalization fits in-distribution data via min-norm interpolation but fails to extrapolate. 3. APE solutions are proven to be pinned to absolute positions within the training length range, so they miss the target entirely when evaluated on longer sequences.
summary_en.experiments: In a minimal one-layer, single-head setup without MLPs trained on sequences up to length 12, RoPE retains 0.83 accuracy at length 48, while APE achieves 1.0 accuracy in-distribution but drops to near-chance (0.07, vs 0.05 random baseline) out of distribution. The findings replicate in a full two-layer, four-head transformer with MLPs and LayerNorm trained on a full-sequence shift task: RoPE remains offset-equivariant out of distribution with a target alignment score of 0.98, while APE shows an alignment score of only 0.02. Ablations confirm that linear attention without softmax fails to extrapolate, matching theoretical predictions.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read in depth over ~45 minutes. Focus on the theoretical results in Sections 3-4 (RoPE equivariance lemma, target-aligned carrier lemma, APE position-pinning proposition), the attention kernel shape comparison for both encoding types in Figure 2, and the counterintuitive softmax ablation in Section 7. Open directions to explore include whether the implicit bias account extends to other relative encodings such as ALiBi and XPos, how modified attention normalization could mitigate softmax dilution to improve extrapolation, and concrete guidance for positional encoding selection in long-context pretraining.

recommendation.zh: 修正长度外推仅由表达性决定的prior，做长上下文训练前必读其证明，明确位置编码的等变性要求。
recommendation.en: Corrects the prior that length extrapolation is purely an expressivity issue; read the proof before long-context training to formalize positional encoding equivariance requirements.

paper.title: Learning to Detect Cross-Modal Negation: An Analysis of Latent Representations and an Attention-Based Solution
paper.abstract: Detecting high-level semantic concepts like negation across modalities remains a challenge for current multimodal systems. We analyze this as a fundamental representation learning problem, providing the first evidence that negation does not form a linearly or non-linearly separable class in the latent spaces of standard vision-language models (VLMs). We demonstrate that pretrained embeddings primarily encode modality-specific features, lacking a generalizable negation signal. To overcome this, w

summary.core_problem: 分析并提升 VLM 对跨模态否定语义的检测能力，特别是图像/视频与文本组合中“否定”是否被表示为可泛化 latent signal。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 VLM 表征分析加小型方法改进。否定是高层语义和组合泛化的典型失败点；如果标准 VLM latent space 中否定不可分，说明当前图文对齐预训练更偏向实体、场景和模态特征，而不是逻辑关系。
summary.technical_approach: 先对标准 VLM 的 latent representations 做线性和非线性可分性分析，发现否定类别不形成稳定可分结构；再提出 cross-modal attention 架构，显式建模文本和视觉之间的依赖。数据侧使用 Qwen2.5-VL 自动标注 3,222 条政治 video-text pairs，并进行统计分析。
summary.experiments: 摘要报告 cross-modal attention 方法相对 unimodal baselines 最高提升 +7.03% F1。实验数据为 3,222 个政治视频-文本配对；未给出被分析 VLM 名称、参数规模、完整 baseline 列表或统计置信区间。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper analyzes and improves VLM detection of cross-modal negation, asking whether negation is represented as a generalizable latent signal across image/video and text.
summary_en.importance: This is a VLM representation-analysis contribution with a modest method component. Negation is a useful stress case for high-level semantics and compositional generalization; if it is not separable in standard VLM latent spaces, current image-text pretraining may be encoding entities, scenes, and modality-specific cues more strongly than logical relations.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors first test whether negation forms a linearly or non-linearly separable class in standard VLM latent representations, then introduce a cross-modal attention architecture to explicitly model dependencies between language and vision. The study uses 3,222 political video-text pairs automatically annotated with Qwen2.5-VL and includes statistical analysis of textual versus visual negation.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports up to +7.03% F1 over unimodal baselines using the proposed cross-modal attention solution. The dataset contains 3,222 political video-text pairs. It does not specify the analyzed VLMs, parameter sizes, full baseline set, or confidence intervals.

recommendation.zh: 看 latent separability 结果即可；数据域偏政治视频，结论别直接推广到通用 VLM 预训练。
recommendation.en: Read the latent-separability analysis; the political-video domain makes broad VLM-pretraining conclusions fragile.

paper.title: Efficient Frame Selection for Long Videos at Test Time with Attention-Based MLLM Selectors
paper.abstract: Understanding long videos with multimodal large language models (MLLMs) requires selecting a compact set of frames from thousands of candidates, yet identifying the right frames seemingly requires understanding the video first. We resolve this circular dependency with a simple observation: cross-modal attention at validation-selected extraction layers in MLLMs already provides query-relevant frame evidence without requiring autoregressive generation. We exploit this property to build DAFS (Dynam

summary.core_problem: 长视频理解中，MLLM 在测试时需要从海量帧里挑少量关键帧，但“要先理解才会选帧”的循环依赖导致成本高、策略难做。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是推理侧的训练-free 选择器：把现成 MLLM 的跨模态注意力当作“相关性证据”来做帧筛选，减少长视频推理的 token/帧开销；对做多模态长上下文/检索式预处理有工程启发，但不直接推进预训练范式。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 DAFS：在 MLLM 的若干“验证挑选的抽取层”读取 cross-modal attention，把 query-conditioned 的注意力聚合成帧级 relevance score，实现跨帧比较且不需要自回归生成；并把“候选帧池大小”和“每帧 token 预算”做离散优化，以适配 selector 自身上下文限制。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出完整基准与数值细节；宣称轻量 selector（2B）即可工作，并且无需训练即可在长视频场景做预算感知的帧选择；需要看正文确认：对比哪些长视频 QA/理解基准、相对 uniform sampling 或 learned selector 的提升与成本曲线。

summary_en.core_problem: For long-video MLLM inference, selecting a small set of relevant frames from thousands is costly and seemingly circular: you need understanding to select frames, but selection is needed for understanding.
summary_en.importance: A training-free, inference-time frame selector that reuses cross-modal attention as relevance evidence to cut token/frame budget. Useful as an engineering trick for long-context multimodal pipelines, but it does not materially advance pretraining methodology.
summary_en.technical_approach: DAFS reads cross-modal attention from a few validation-chosen extraction layers, aggregates it in a query-conditioned way into frame-level relevance scores, enabling cross-frame ranking without autoregressive decoding; additionally solves a discrete budget allocation over candidate pool size and per-frame token budget under the selector’s context limit.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract omits concrete benchmark numbers; claims a lightweight 2B selector works training-free and is budget-aware. Needs verification in the paper: which long-video benchmarks, baselines (uniform sampling / learned selectors), and cost–quality tradeoff curves.

recommendation.zh: 把 cross-modal attention 当“免费检索信号”挺实用，但更像推理管线技巧；只需看方法和成本-效果曲线，别当成预训练结论。
recommendation.en: Treating cross-modal attention as a “free retrieval signal” is a handy inference trick, but it’s pipeline engineering; skim the method and cost–quality curves, not as a pretraining takeaway.

paper.title: Relevant and Irrelevant: A Renormalization Group Analysis of Transformer Attention
paper.abstract: Using the language of Wilsonian renormalization group theory (RG), we treat the Transformer's attention mechanism as a perturbation of the trained MLP residual-stack fixed point and ask whether it constitutes a relevant, marginal, or irrelevant operator. We derive a fixed-point shift formula and obtain four testable predictions for the fixed-point geometry, effective rank profile, layer specificity, and perturbation decay spectrum. Testing these on synthetic Markov chain sequences with controlle

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要回答的不是“注意力有没有用”这种经验问题，而是一个更窄也更可检验的问题：在一个已经训练好的、呈现出固定点平台的残差 MLP 表征流里，加入 attention 以后，它在表示动力学上到底是 relevant、marginal 还是 irrelevant perturbation。作者把 Transformer 的层间表征演化当作一种离散 RG flow，先以纯 MLP masked-LM 在可控 Markov 链数据上的固定点结构为基线，再分析 attention 是否只会对固定点做小幅平移，还是会把系统推向另一类 attractor。核心对象不是通用自然语言，而是相关长度 ξ 可控的合成序列；这样做的目的，是把“什么时候需要 attention”从经验叙述变成与输入统计结构直接挂钩的可证伪命题。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接影响不在于给出新的训练 recipe，而在于提供了一种分析建模范式必要性的框架。它试图解释：为什么在短相关、局部统计足够的分布上，深残差 MLP 可能已经接近最优；而在长相关分布上，attention 会从“可有可无的增强项”变成决定性算子。这个判断如果成立，对架构选择、数据分布匹配、甚至 any-order / masked 建模里 attention 的必要性都有启发。贡献量级更接近“机制分析工具”而不是“可直接落地的系统改进”：它把 attention 的收益和输入相关长度、有效秩、层特异性、扰动衰减谱联系起来，给出了一套可以在受控环境中验证的预测。对做基座预训练的人，价值在于它提供了一个比单看 loss 更细的中间层诊断视角。
summary.technical_approach: 方法上分两步。第一步，作者沿用前作中的设定：在词表大小 16、长度 T=64 的 Markov 链序列上做 BERT-style masked token prediction，比较纯 pre-norm MLP residual stack 与加入 pre-norm multi-head self-attention 的匹配架构。MLP 基线使用 d=64、L=6、MLP hidden size 4d、GELU，Adam 学习率 3e-4，batch size 32，训练 10k steps，并且每步采样新序列，尽量避免有限数据记忆效应。第二步，作者把 attention 视为对 MLP 固定点的扰动项，在固定点附近做线性化，得到固定点位移公式 δ = - M*^{-1}(a+b)。这里 M* 对应 MLP 固定点附近的稳定性/响应算子，a、b 则编码 attention 引入的一阶与耦合项。这个公式不是为了精确预测每个神经元，而是为了导出四类可测预测：固定点几何是否发生位移或 attractor 切换；有效秩 profile 是否出现跃迁；attention 的作用是否集中在少数关键层；扰动是否随深度衰减、保持还是放大。作者随后把“relevant / marginal / irrelevant” operationalize 为这些量在深度方向上的行为模式。与常见的表示分析不同，这里不是事后看 attention map，而是先从固定点扰动理论推出可检验现象，再回到训练后网络测量 kernel drift、rank、层间变化和损失差距。文章的关键区别在于：它把 attention 当成一个 operator class，而不是把 Transformer 当作不可分解的整体黑箱。
summary.experiments: 实验全部建立在两种相关长度 regime 上。短相关链：α=10，第二特征值约 0.44，对应 ξ≈1.2，约 5 步内去相关。长相关链：α=0.05，第二特征值约 0.86，对应 ξ≈6.7，mixing time 约 31，长度 64 的上下文仍保留明显预测信息。作者报告的主结论有四点。第一，在长 ξ 条件下，attention 是 strongly relevant：纯 MLP 留下无法弥合的 residual loss gap，而加入 attention 后该 gap 被显著关闭，同时表征空间出现类似 phase transition 的变化；摘要里明确提到 effective rank 会跳升到高于输入维度。第二，在短 ξ 条件下，attention 基本 irrelevant：MLP 已经能完成所需 coarse-graining，加入 attention 后固定点几何和 rank profile 变化很小，性能收益有限。第三，attention 的作用具有明显层特异性，不是每层均匀起作用，而是集中在一两个 transition layer，这与前作里 MLP kernel drift 集中在少数层的现象呼应。第四，扰动衰减谱与 ξ 相关：长相关输入下，attention 诱发的扰动不会快速衰减，甚至会沿深度被放大；短相关下则更接近衰减型。就数值设定而言，模型规模较小，重点不在绝对性能，而在 controlled setup 下验证预测。摘要给出的最具体数字包括：短 ξ 时纯 MLP 出现约 8.4× 的单调 rank collapse；长 ξ 时 MLP 保持较高有效秩，而 attention 进一步触发 rank jump。若精读正文，应重点核对各节中 loss gap、kernel drift concentration、effective rank 曲线和 perturbation decay 的具体图表，而不是只看最终准确率。
