summary.reading_guide: 这篇更适合带着问题读。先看 Introduction 和 Background，确认作者前作里的“MLP residual stack 自发形成 fixed-point plateau”这个前提是否站得住；如果不接受这个前提，后面的 RG 语言会显得过重。然后直接看提出固定点位移公式和四个预测的那一节，这是全文最关键的地方：要弄清楚 δ = - M*^{-1}(a+b) 里的各项在网络测量上分别对应什么，作者如何把抽象的 relevant / irrelevant 变成可观测指标。实验部分建议优先看比较短 ξ 与长 ξ 的图，尤其是 effective rank 随层变化、kernel drift 集中在哪些层、attention 与 MLP 的 loss gap 是否只在长 ξ 下显著。阅读时间大约 30-45 分钟。泛读时不必深究附录推导细节，但值得追问两个点：一是“effective rank 高于输入维度”在 one-hot 输入设定下具体如何定义，是否受投影层和 LayerNorm 影响；二是这种结论能否迁移到真实语料，其中相关结构远不止一阶 Markov。把它当作一个受控机制实验来读，会比把它当作通用 Transformer 理论更合适。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks a sharply defined question: if a trained residual MLP stack already exhibits a fixed-point plateau in representation space, what is self-attention in that dynamical system—a relevant, marginal, or irrelevant perturbation? Instead of arguing from aggregate accuracy, the authors cast layerwise representation evolution as a discrete renormalization-group (RG) flow, use the pure MLP masked-LM as the reference fixed point, and study whether adding attention merely shifts that fixed point or drives the network toward a different attractor. The setup is intentionally controlled: synthetic Markov-chain sequences with tunable correlation length ξ. That lets them tie the usefulness of attention to input statistics rather than to broad empirical claims about language.
summary_en.importance: Its value for pretraining research is conceptual rather than recipe-oriented. The paper offers a way to reason about when attention is structurally necessary, versus when a deep residual MLP may already be sufficient for the statistics of the data. If the argument holds, it informs architecture choice under different correlation regimes, and it is relevant beyond standard AR language modeling: masked LM, any-order modeling, and other alternatives still face the same question of what long-range dependency operator is actually needed. The contribution is best viewed as a mechanistic analysis framework. It links attention’s role to correlation length, effective-rank evolution, layer specificity, and perturbation decay, giving a set of falsifiable predictions rather than a post-hoc interpretation of attention maps.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method has two layers. First, the authors reuse a controlled setup from prior work: BERT-style masked token prediction on Markov-chain sequences with vocabulary size 16 and sequence length T=64. The baseline is a pre-norm residual MLP stack with d=64, L=6, MLP width 4d, GELU, final LayerNorm, and a token classifier; training uses Adam at 3e-4, batch size 32, for 10k steps with freshly sampled sequences each step. A matched architecture adds pre-norm multi-head self-attention to each residual block. Second, they treat attention as a perturbing operator around the MLP fixed point and linearize the dynamics near that point, deriving the fixed-point shift formula δ = -M*^{-1}(a+b). Here M* plays the role of the local response/stability operator of the MLP fixed point, while a and b encode first-order and coupling terms induced by attention. The formula is not used to predict neuron-level states directly; instead it yields four measurable predictions: whether the fixed-point geometry shifts or changes attractor class, whether the effective-rank profile changes qualitatively, whether attention acts in a layer-specific way, and whether the perturbation decays, persists, or amplifies with depth. This is the key distinction from standard representation analysis: the paper starts from a perturbative theory and then checks kernel drift, rank evolution, layer transitions, and residual loss gaps in trained networks.
summary_en.experiments: All experiments compare two correlation regimes. In the short-correlation regime, α=10 gives λ2≈0.44 and ξ≈1.2, so sequences decorrelate within roughly five steps. In the long-correlation regime, α=0.05 gives λ2≈0.86 and ξ≈6.7, with mixing time around 31, so a context window of length 64 still carries substantial predictive signal. The main empirical findings are: (1) for long ξ, attention is strongly relevant—it closes a residual loss gap that the MLP cannot bridge and induces a phase-transition-like change in representation space; the abstract explicitly notes an effective-rank jump above the input dimension. (2) For short ξ, attention is largely irrelevant—the MLP already performs the needed coarse-graining, and adding attention changes neither the fixed-point geometry nor the rank profile much, with limited performance gain. (3) Attention is layer-specific rather than uniformly useful across depth; its effect concentrates around one or two transition layers, echoing the earlier observation that kernel drift in the MLP baseline is itself concentrated. (4) The perturbation decay spectrum depends on ξ: under long-range correlations, attention-induced perturbations do not simply die out and may amplify with depth, whereas under short-range correlations they behave more like irrelevant perturbations. The setup is small by design, so the point is not headline benchmark performance but validation of the predicted diagnostics. The most concrete numbers exposed in the provided text are the ~8.4× monotone rank collapse for the short-ξ MLP baseline and the long-ξ regime where rank is preserved and then further altered by attention.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read it as a controlled mechanism paper, not as a general theory of Transformers. Start with the introduction and background to verify the premise inherited from the previous work: a pure residual MLP trained on masked prediction develops a fixed-point plateau in representation space. Then go straight to the section deriving the fixed-point shift formula and the four predictions. That is the center of the paper. The important question is not the algebra alone, but how each term is operationalized in actual network measurements. In the experiments, focus on the short-ξ versus long-ξ comparisons: effective-rank trajectories across layers, where kernel drift concentrates, and whether the attention–MLP loss gap appears only in the long-correlation regime. A skim should take about 30–45 minutes. Two details are worth checking carefully if you go deeper: how “effective rank above input dimension” is defined under one-hot inputs with learned projections and LayerNorm, and how far the conclusions might transfer beyond first-order Markov data to real corpora with richer dependency structure.

recommendation.zh: 只看 RG 形式化和长/短相关链对照；结论不该外推到真实预训练，但会修正“attention 总是核心”的直觉。
recommendation.en: Read the RG framing and the long-vs-short correlation contrast; do not over-extrapolate, but it weakens the reflex that attention is always the decisive component.

paper.title: Legible-by-Construction: Attention and End-to-End Transformers
paper.abstract: A companion paper showed that a transformer's feed-forward layer can be rebuilt from explicit fuzzy set operations - intersection, set-difference, and a self-forgetting sequence quantifier - so its hidden units read as named logical operators at no cost to language-model quality. That left the other half of the transformer opaque. Here we carry the same idea into attention and join the two into one model. The mechanism is minimal: a head's value is passed through a sigmoid, so each value channel

summary.core_problem: 论文试图让 Transformer 的 attention 路径在结构上更可读，而不是训练后再用 probing、logit lens 或 sparse autoencoder 解释。核心问题是 attention 的 QK 路径相对容易理解为“看哪里”，但 OV 路径很难解释为“写什么”。作者提出把 value 通道约束成可读的模糊集合成员关系，同时保持输出投影自由。
summary.importance: 这是一篇架构与机制解释交界的工作。它的价值不在语言建模指标提升，而在提出一种可训练的可解释 attention 设计：约束检测对象，不约束写入方式。这个原则对预训练研究有启发，因为很多可解释性约束会损伤模型容量，或者给优化器留下无意义捷径。这里的设计尝试保留标准 attention 的主要自由度，只在 value 上加 sigmoid 边界和选择性压力，让通道更像“某个特征是否成立”的检测器。
summary.technical_approach: 主要改动是将每个 head 的 value 写成 v = sigmoid(W_v x)，把 value channel 限制在 [0, 1]，解释为 fuzzy membership。attention 对这些 membership 做上下文聚合，输出投影仍然完全自由。这个 bounded-value / free-readout 设计是关键：如果反过来约束输出写入，例如把 head output 绑到词表空间，模型可能走上下文无关常量的梯度捷径，表面可读但没有实际选择性。论文还讨论 Boolean variant，把 value 进一步组织成显式的 within-token intersection 与 set-difference，使 OV 路径更接近逻辑操作。训练上加入两类压力：sparsity 让检测器只在少数上下文触发，crispness 让激活靠近 0 或 1。不同设计需要不同正则：单一 membership value 需要 sparsity 和 crispness；显式 conjunction 已经天然稀疏，更适合只加 crispness，否则容易变成死通道。
summary.experiments: 实验在 125M 参数规模上比较五种 specialized-attention 设计。结果显示，bounded value 设计中有 44% 到 62% 的 value channels 形成清晰、上下文选择性的检测器；与之对比，vocabulary-tied 设计出现 constant-collapse。层深也有明显影响：最深层可选择通道比例达到 70% 到 95%，并能读出较稳定的语义和语法特征，例如抽象概念、领域、人物/复数相关通道。论文还报告该 attention 设计可以和 companion work 中的 legible FFN 合并成端到端 Transformer，并声称没有牺牲语言模型质量。最有信息量的消融是约束位置和正则位置：约束 value 而不是 output，正则 operands 而不是组合后的 operator output。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读 25 到 30 分钟。先看 Introduction 对 QK/OV 可读性差异的分析，再看 Section 3 关于为什么不能约束 write/output，尤其是 vocabulary-tied 设计的失败原因。Section 3.6 和 Section 4 是重点：前者解释 sparsity、crispness 应该施加在哪里，后者给出 125M 模型上各设计的选择性比例和通道示例。若关心可解释架构是否能扩展到大模型，需要额外检查训练开销、困惑度对比、正则强度敏感性，以及这些通道在更大数据规模下是否仍保持可读。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the opacity of the attention OV path. QK patterns are relatively interpretable as where a head attends, while the value and output path is much harder to read as what the head contributes. The goal is to make attention legible by construction rather than relying only on post-hoc interpretability tools.
summary_en.importance: The contribution sits between architecture design and mechanistic interpretability. Its main lesson for pretraining researchers is about where to place interpretability constraints. Constraining the detector side of a head can make channels readable while preserving a free output projection; constraining the write side can create optimization shortcuts and collapse to context-independent behavior. This is a useful design principle for building models whose internal units are easier to inspect without directly tying them to vocabulary outputs.
summary_en.technical_approach: The core modification is minimal: replace the raw value with a bounded membership value, v = sigmoid(W_v x), so each value channel lies in [0, 1] and can be interpreted as whether a feature holds at the token. Attention then aggregates these memberships over context, while the output projection remains unconstrained. This bounded-value/free-readout split is the central mechanism. The paper also studies a Boolean variant in which values are structured as explicit within-token intersections and set differences, mirroring the legible FFN operators from the companion work. Training uses two pressures: sparsity, to make detectors fire only in selected contexts, and crispness, to push activations toward 0 or 1. The paper emphasizes that the pressure must match the operator: a single membership value benefits from both, while an explicit conjunction is already sparse and mainly needs crispness.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments use 125M-parameter models and compare five specialized attention designs. In the bounded-value designs, 44% to 62% of value channels become crisp and context-selective, whereas the vocabulary-tied design collapses to constants. Selectivity increases with depth: the deepest layers reach 70% to 95% selective channels, with interpretable examples tied to semantic and grammatical features such as abstract concepts, domains, and people/plural distinctions. The paper also combines legible attention with the earlier legible FFN into an end-to-end Transformer and reports no language-model quality loss. The important ablations concern the location of the constraint and regularization: constrain the value, not the output; regularize operator operands, not only the combined output.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 25–30 minute skim is enough. Start with the introduction for the QK-versus-OV framing. Then read Section 3 for the failure mode of constraining the write/output path, especially the vocabulary-tied shortcut. Sections 3.6 and 4 are the most useful parts: they explain the sparsity/crispness pressures and show the 125M-scale channel selectivity results. For deeper follow-up, inspect perplexity trade-offs, sensitivity to regularization strength, and whether the same legibility survives larger models and broader pretraining data.

recommendation.zh: 不是 pretrain 主线，但它在“attention 可解释性要约束哪里”上给了清楚立场；先看方法假设和可视化，性能结论先当弱信号。
recommendation.en: Not core pretraining, but it makes a clean claim about where interpretability constraints should live in attention; read the construction and visual evidence first, treat the quality claim as provisional.

paper.title: Towards Memory-Efficient Autoregressive Video Generation via Instance-Specific Parametric Absorption
paper.abstract: Autoregressive (AR) streaming models have emerged as a powerful paradigm for long video generation. However, the linearly growing Key-Value (KV) cache poses a significant bottleneck, leading to memory overload and degraded inference throughput. A common compression method is to drop redundant KV tokens, which often breaks long-range dependencies, resulting in temporal flickering and identity loss. In this paper, we propose Instance-Specific Parametric Absorption (ISPA), a novel framework that sh

summary.core_problem: 解决自回归长视频生成中 KV cache 随时间线性增长，导致显存爆炸和吞吐下降的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献属于推理效率与缓存压缩。虽然场景是视频生成，不是文本 LLM，但“不要丢 KV，而是把历史吸收到参数里”的思路，对长上下文推理和实例级缓存压缩有一定启发。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 ISPA（Instance-Specific Parametric Absorption）。方法在短暂 warmup 后，监控全局注意力与局部注意力的输出差异，在切换点求解一个闭式最小二乘问题，得到 instance-specific 的权重调制项，把历史上下文“吸收”进部分层参数中；随后将部分层从 full attention 切到 local attention，以减少 KV cache 负担。
summary.experiments: 摘要表明其目标是 AR streaming video generation，主要对比常见的 KV token 丢弃式压缩方法，关注显存、吞吐以及时序闪烁和身份保持。未在摘要中给出模型参数量、数据规模和具体提升幅度。

summary_en.core_problem: It addresses the linear KV-cache growth in autoregressive long-video generation, which causes memory blow-up and poor inference throughput.
summary_en.importance: This is an inference-efficiency paper. The setting is video generation rather than text LLMs, but the idea of absorbing history into parameters instead of dropping KV tokens is still mildly relevant for long-context inference research.
summary_en.technical_approach: ISPA (Instance-Specific Parametric Absorption) performs a brief warmup, measures the discrepancy between global and local attention, and at a transition point solves a closed-form least-squares problem to obtain an instance-specific weight modulation. This lets some layers switch from full attention to local attention while compensating for lost global context through temporary parameter adaptation.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract indicates evaluation on autoregressive streaming video generation, mainly against token-dropping KV compression baselines, with metrics around memory, throughput, temporal flicker, and identity preservation. Model size, data scale, and exact gains are not provided in the abstract.

recommendation.zh: 不是文本 LLM，但思路有点意思：把 cache 压缩从删 token 改成实例级参数吸收。先看闭式解那一节；若代价太高，对 LLM 未必成立。
recommendation.en: Not a text-LLM paper, but the angle is interesting: turn cache compression from token dropping into instance-specific parameter absorption. Read the closed-form adaptation section first; the overhead may kill it for LLMs.

paper.title: ATMA: Length-Invariant Language Modeling via Polar Attention and Gated-Delta Compression Memory
paper.abstract: Modern large language models based on softmax scaled-dot-product attention are constrained by their training sequence length: as the key-value sequence grows, softmax probability mass can dilute across a wider distribution, inducing activation shift and long-context performance collapse. Moreover, long-context language modeling faces a structural tension: a sliding-window attention core maintains a bounded local representation and low perplexity but is blind to long-range dependencies, while ful

summary.core_problem: ATMA 处理的是长上下文长度外推中的两个耦合问题：softmax attention 在键数量增大后会出现概率质量稀释，导致激活分布偏离训练长度；而滑窗注意力虽然局部困惑度稳定，却丢失窗口外检索能力。作者试图用一种有界的全局读出机制，加上可压缩的长期记忆，同时保住局部语言建模和远距离精确召回。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发主要在架构与训练动态层面。它不是简单扩大窗口或换位置编码，而是把长上下文失败归因到 attention 输出的尺度和分布漂移，并将“匹配内容”和“匹配数量”显式解耦。这一思路值得关注，因为长上下文预训练常见的问题不是只缺少全局信息，而是全局信息进入 residual stream 的方式会改变模型在训练长度内学到的激活统计。不过实验规模仍偏小，370M、1B tokens 的结论更适合作为架构假设和消融证据，不能直接外推到多十亿参数和万亿 token 训练。
summary.technical_approach: ATMA 是 16 层 decoder-only 模型，采用 3:1 的混合序列混合比例：12 层 LFM2 gated convolution 负责稳定的局部建模，4 层 Polar Attention 提供稀疏插入的全局读出。每个 block 使用 pre-norm，MLP 是 4 倍扩展的 squared-ReLU。核心是三通道 attention 输出。第一是 content channel：对匹配到的 value-sum 做单位球投影，只保留方向，减少上下文长度变化带来的幅度漂移。第二是 count channel：用 participation ratio，也就是 inverse Simpson index，估计有多少 key 参与了匹配，再经过饱和单调映射得到有界计数信号。这样“匹配到了什么”和“匹配了多少”不再混在 softmax 归一化输出里。第三是 memory channel：引入 per-head recurrent associative memory，使用类似 Titans 的 gated-delta update，把长文档趋势压缩成有损记忆。Polar Attention 负责精确全局读出，memory 负责长期语义和困惑度趋势。作者还加入 extreme-value-corrected null floor，用学习到的随机匹配上界校准 logits，避免极长序列中的背景噪声淹没有效匹配。
summary.experiments: 实验包括 100-run factorial ablation。模型规模为 370M，在 1B token FineWeb-Edu 上训练，并在 2K 到 64K 上评估，最长达到训练长度的 32 倍。主要结论是 Polar Attention 和 gated-delta memory 必须组合使用：无 memory 的 Polar Attention 在长距离检索上仍会退化；softmax 加同样 memory 在极长长度下仍有困惑度和激活漂移问题。ATMA 在 2K 到 64K 的 induction needle-in-a-haystack 检索中保持 90% 以上，同时 clean-document perplexity 随上下文变长单调改善。系统实现方面，作者提供 PyTorch reference、FP16/FP8 training harness 和 paged inference engine，并实现 FlashAttention 风格 Triton kernel 来流式计算 participation ratio；gated-delta 训练 recurrence 通过 custom ops 避免 dynamo graph break。报告中称 recurrent memory 分支在 NVIDIA L4 上带来约 4.5 个百分点 MFU 下降。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 30 到 45 分钟。重点看 Introduction 中对 softmax dilution 和滑窗/全局注意力取舍的定义，再看 Methodology 里三通道 Polar Attention 的公式和 gated-delta memory 的接口。实验部分优先看 100-run factorial ablation、2K→64K 长度外推曲线、needle 检索和 clean perplexity 的联合结果。值得深挖的是 participation ratio 是否稳定、null floor 如何估计、content 单位化会不会损失强度信息，以及这些设计在更大 batch、更深模型和真实长文预训练中是否仍然稳定。

summary_en.core_problem: ATMA targets a specific failure mode in long-context language modeling: softmax attention changes its output statistics as the number of keys grows, while sliding-window attention avoids this shift only by giving up recall beyond the window. The goal is to keep local language modeling stable and still support precise retrieval at lengths far beyond training.
summary_en.importance: The useful signal for pretraining research is architectural rather than data-related. The work treats long-context collapse as an activation-distribution problem, not only as a positional-encoding or context-size problem. Its main idea is to separate content from count in the attention readout, then add a recurrent compressed memory for long-range document state. The evidence is still small-scale: 370M parameters and 1B training tokens are enough for controlled ablations, but not enough to establish behavior at frontier-scale training.
summary_en.technical_approach: ATMA is a 16-layer decoder-only model with a 3:1 hybrid mixing schedule: 12 LFM2 gated convolution layers and 4 Polar Attention layers. The blocks use pre-normalization and a 4x squared-ReLU MLP. Polar Attention replaces the usual softmax readout with three additive streams. The content stream normalizes the matched value sum onto the unit sphere, preserving direction while removing length-dependent magnitude. The count stream estimates how many items participated in the match using the participation ratio, or inverse Simpson index, then bounds it through a saturating monotone map. This explicitly decouples what was matched from how much was matched. The memory stream is a per-head recurrent associative memory with a gated-delta update, inspired by Titans. The recurrent path carries a lossy long-term gist, while Polar Attention provides bounded full-context retrieval. An extreme-value-corrected learned null floor is used to calibrate logits against the expected maximum score from random background matches.
summary_en.experiments: The main study is a 100-run factorial ablation with 370M-parameter models trained on 1B FineWeb-Edu tokens. Models are evaluated from 2K to 64K context length, up to 32 times the training length. The reported pattern is clear: Polar Attention without memory still loses retrieval at long range, and softmax paired with the same memory still collapses at extreme lengths. The full ATMA configuration keeps induction needle-in-a-haystack retrieval above 90% across the 2K-to-64K sweep, while clean-document perplexity improves as more context is available. On the systems side, the implementation includes a PyTorch reference, an FP16/FP8 training harness, a paged inference engine, and a FlashAttention-style Triton kernel for streaming participation-ratio computation. The recurrent memory branch is reported to cost about 4.5 percentage points of MFU on NVIDIA L4 GPUs.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 30- to 45-minute skim is enough. Read the motivation around softmax dilution and the window-versus-retrieval trade-off first. Then focus on the Polar Attention equations, especially the content normalization, participation-ratio count channel, and null-floor calibration. In the experiments, prioritize the factorial ablations and the 2K-to-64K curves for retrieval and perplexity. The main questions to carry forward are whether the count statistic remains stable at larger scale, whether unit-normalized content loses useful magnitude information, and whether the memory branch interacts cleanly with deeper pretrained models.

recommendation.zh: 这是在正面挑战 softmax attention 长度外推 prior；先看方法图和长上下文曲线，若 baseline 只打滑窗而没打 Hyena/RWKV/linear attention，就当弱信号。
recommendation.en: This directly challenges the softmax-attention prior on length extrapolation; read the method figure and long-context curves first, and treat it as weak evidence if the baselines stop at sliding-window attention.

paper.title: Attention is Just Another Name for Coupling?: A Fast-Slow ODE Perspective on Hierarchical Pretraining
paper.abstract: Causal self-attention is a coupling mechanism: each token's hidden state is updated by a learned mixture of preceding tokens at the same timescale. This paper asks whether a second, temporally slower coupling-a slow sub-system operating on a temporally-downsampled view of the sequence and fed back into the fast path through a zero-initialised gate-complements it. The question is framed in the language of singularly perturbed ordinary differential equations (ODEs), where the fast variable $x$ evo

summary.core_problem: 提出在标准因果自注意力（快路径）之外，加入一条按时间降采样的慢耦合路径，形成快-慢 ODE 视角的层级预训练架构。
summary.importance: 为层级建模/长程依赖提供一个有理论 ODE 动机、计算便宜的架构改动思路，与 hierarchical pretraining 思路相关。
summary.technical_approach: 用奇异摄动 ODE 建模：快变量 x 在 token 粒度更新，慢变量 y 每 P 个 token 通过因果块均值池化更新；慢路径在 T/P 个池化 token 上做 full attention（单层便宜 P² 倍），通过零初始化门控加回快路径，保证初始行为等价于原 Transformer。
summary.experiments: 提出架构构造并在线性生成器假设下做理论推导，摘要未给出大规模 LLM 实验对比。

summary_en.core_problem: Augment causal self-attention (fast path) with a temporally downsampled slow-coupling path, formalized through a fast-slow ODE view of hierarchical pretraining.
summary_en.importance: Proposes a theoretically motivated, cheap architectural change for modeling hierarchy and long-range dependency, relevant to hierarchical pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: Singularly perturbed ODE: fast variable x at token rate, slow variable y updated every P tokens via causal block-mean pooling; slow path runs full attention over T/P pooled tokens (P² cheaper per layer) and is added back through a zero-init gate, preserving identity initialization.
summary_en.experiments: Architecture and theory under a linear-generator assumption are presented; large-scale LLM ablations are not reported in the abstract.

recommendation.zh: 慢路径 + 零初始化门控是干净的可插拔改动，建议在中小规模 ablation 上先测 long-context 和稳定性，再谈预训练收益。
recommendation.en: The slow path with zero-init gating is a clean plug-in; run small-to-medium ablations on long-context and stability before betting pretraining compute on it.

paper.title: Looking Is Not Picking: An Attention-Segment Account of Tool-Selection Failures in LLM Agents
paper.abstract: LLM agents mis-call tools, and the natural guess is that the model failed to see the right tool in a crowded harness. We show the opposite through a lens concurrent work sets aside -- the model's attention to labeled tool-definition segments. On real BFCL failures, by per-candidate attention argmax the model attends most to the correct tool 80% of the time (vs. 21% chance), and the gold is the under-attended segment on only 10%: it looks at the right tool and still picks wrong. This directly ref

summary.core_problem: 解释 LLM agent 的工具选择失败究竟来自“没看到正确工具”，还是来自看到之后的决策读出错误。
summary.importance: 这是一篇机制分析工作。它不直接改进预训练，但对 tool-use agent 的错误归因很干净：把问题从 prompt/harness 拥挤，转向 readout/decision layer。对做 agentic pretrain、tool token 建模、后训练诊断的人有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 作者用 attention-segment 视角分析真实 BFCL 失败样本，统计模型对带标签工具定义片段的注意力 argmax 是否落在正确工具上。随后比较两类干预：输入侧修补（重排、复制 gold tool）与读出侧干预（attention-logit bias、residual-stream steering）。如果输入侧收益有限而读出侧显著恢复，就说明失败主要发生在决策读出而非检索可见性。
summary.experiments: 摘要给出几个关键数字：在真实 BFCL 失败中，模型有 80% 的情况最关注正确工具片段，远高于 21% 的随机机会；只有 10% 的失败是 gold tool 明显欠关注。输入侧 prompt 修补最多恢复不超过 23% 的失败，而读出侧干预可恢复 59%-91%。这不是 benchmark 扩展，而是对失败机制的定量拆解。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether tool-selection failures in LLM agents come from not attending to the correct tool or from making the wrong decision after seeing it.
summary_en.importance: This is a mechanistic analysis rather than a new training method. Its value is in clean error attribution: it shifts the diagnosis from crowded prompts and harness layout toward the readout/decision stage. That matters for agentic pretraining, tool-token modeling, and post-training diagnostics.
summary_en.technical_approach: The author analyzes real BFCL failures through an attention-segment lens, checking whether per-candidate attention argmax lands on the correct labeled tool-definition segment. It then contrasts input-side fixes—reordering or duplicating the gold tool—with readout-side interventions such as additive attention-logit bias and residual-stream steering. If prompt repairs help little but readout interventions recover many failures, the bottleneck is the decision readout rather than visibility.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports several useful numbers: on real BFCL failures, the model attends most to the correct tool 80% of the time versus a 21% chance baseline, and the gold tool is under-attended in only 10% of cases. Prompt-side repairs recover at most 23% of failures, while readout-side interventions recover 59% to 91%. The contribution is a quantitative decomposition of failure modes, not a new benchmark.

recommendation.zh: 这篇最有用的是把 tool failure 从“检索不到”改判成“读出错了”；只看摘要里的数字和读出干预结果，就足够改你的诊断 prior。
recommendation.en: Useful because it flips the diagnosis of tool failures from retrieval/visibility to readout error; the abstract numbers plus the readout interventions are enough to update your prior.

paper.title: Formalizing and Mitigating Structural Distortion in LLM Attention for Zero-Shot Graph Reasoning
paper.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown promise for reasoning over Text-Attributed Graphs (TAGs). However, applying LLMs to graphs requires linearizing their structure into sequences, introducing distortion rooted in the graph bandwidth problem. While this distortion has been shown to degrade performance, it is often attributed to prompt design or model scale, leaving the underlying mechanism unclear. In this work, we show \textit{how} rotary positional embeddings turn graph linearization into b

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解释一个常被归因于 prompt 或模型规模的问题：LLM 做零样本图推理时，为什么把图线性化成序列会系统性损伤结构推理能力。
summary.importance: 价值在于它把现象落到一个清楚的机制上：RoPE 的相对位置衰减会把图线性化误差转成 bandwidth-dependent attention decay。这个结论虽然来自图推理，但本质是在分析位置编码如何扭曲非序列结构，对长上下文、结构化输入和 attention bias 设计都有启发。
summary.technical_approach: 作者先形式化 graph serialization distortion 与 graph bandwidth 的关系，再指出使用 rotary positional embeddings 时，序列中被拉远的图相邻节点会因相对位置增大而受到更强注意力衰减，导致 attention 与真实图邻接关系错位。基于这一分析，提出 GaLA（Graph-aligned Language Attention），一种轻量级 inference-time attention 修改方法，在不重训模型的前提下，对图相邻节点施加额外注意力偏置，以纠正结构失真。
summary.experiments: 摘要显示实验聚焦零样本 TAG（text-attributed graph）推理，比较原始 LLM 与加入 GaLA 后的表现，并验证性能与图带宽/线性化失真之间的关系。论文的关键看点不是绝对分数，而是机制证据是否干净：即 attention decay 是否真的随 graph bandwidth 恶化，以及 inference-time bias 是否能在不改参数的情况下恢复部分结构推理能力。摘要未给出模型规模和具体提升幅度。
summary.authors_note: 作者包含 Edward W. Huang、Danai Koutra，来自图学习与机器学习方向较活跃的研究团队。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper explains a phenomenon often blamed on prompting or model scale: why zero-shot graph reasoning degrades when graphs are serialized into sequences for LLMs.
summary_en.importance: Its value is the mechanism: RoPE turns graph linearization error into bandwidth-dependent attention decay. Although the application is graph reasoning, the underlying lesson is about how positional encoding distorts non-sequential structure, which matters for long-context and structured-input modeling more broadly.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors formalize the distortion induced by graph serialization through graph bandwidth, then show that with rotary positional embeddings, graph-adjacent nodes that become far apart in the serialized sequence suffer stronger relative-position-based attention decay. This creates a mismatch between attention and true graph adjacency. Motivated by this, they propose GaLA (Graph-aligned Language Attention), a lightweight inference-time attention modification that biases attention toward graph-adjacent nodes without retraining the model.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments target zero-shot reasoning on text-attributed graphs, comparing vanilla LLMs against GaLA and validating the link between performance and graph bandwidth / serialization distortion. The main thing to inspect is not the headline score but whether the mechanism is cleanly demonstrated: does attention decay worsen with graph bandwidth, and can an inference-time bias recover structure-sensitive reasoning without parameter updates? The abstract does not provide model sizes or exact gains.
summary_en.authors_note: The author list includes Edward W. Huang and Danai Koutra, from a research group active in graph learning and machine learning.

recommendation.zh: 虽然是图推理题材，但真正值得看的是它把 RoPE 的位置衰减问题讲得很具体；读机制部分和 GaLA 设计，别把任务分数当重点。
recommendation.en: The graph angle is secondary; what matters is the concrete mechanism for RoPE-induced structural distortion—read the analysis and GaLA design, not the benchmark score.

paper.title: Boltzmann Attention: Learnable Ising Couplings for Cooperative Attention
paper.abstract: Attention mechanisms are central to modern sequence models, yet standard attention computes relevance primarily through individual query--key similarities. Although softmax normalization introduces competition among positions, a standard attention layer does not explicitly parameterize learnable interactions between attention decisions. This limits its ability to directly model cooperative or antagonistic co-attention structure within the attention mechanism itself. We propose Boltzmann attentio

summary.core_problem: 标准 attention 主要依赖 query-key 相似度，缺少对不同注意力选择之间协同或抑制关系的显式可学习建模。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是架构和建模机制改进。它把 attention pattern 视为带相互作用的 Ising 模型，提供一种 energy-based attention 设计，但证据仍停留在字符级语言建模和合成括号匹配，尚不足以说明大模型预训练收益。
summary.technical_approach: Boltzmann attention 在常规数据相关 local fields 之外加入可学习 pairwise couplings，使注意力位置之间存在显式相互作用。注意力分布由交互式 Ising 能量模型决定，可以表示 softmax 或 sigmoid attention 不直接参数化的 inter-position correlation。
summary.experiments: 实验包括 character-level language modeling 和 synthetic bracket matching。摘要称在标准 Transformer 内，相比 standard softmax attention 有稳定提升，但未给出参数量、数据规模、训练预算或具体提升数字。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets the lack of explicit learnable interactions among attention decisions in standard query-key attention.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an architectural mechanism: an energy-based attention layer with Ising-style couplings. It is conceptually relevant to language-model architecture, but the evidence is limited to small character-level and synthetic tasks.
summary_en.technical_approach: Boltzmann attention augments data-dependent local fields with learnable pairwise couplings between attention decisions. Attention patterns are governed by an interacting Ising model, allowing cooperative or antagonistic correlations across positions beyond standard softmax normalization.
summary_en.experiments: The reported evaluations cover character-level language modeling and synthetic bracket matching. The abstract claims consistent gains over standard softmax attention inside a Transformer, but does not provide model scale, data scale, compute, or exact numbers.

recommendation.zh: 想法比证据强；只看 energy 形式和采样/近似代价，别把小规模字符 LM 结果外推到预训练。
recommendation.en: The idea is stronger than the evidence; inspect the energy form and approximation cost, but do not extrapolate char-LM gains to pretraining.

paper.title: Beyond Fully Random Masking: Attention-Guided Denoising and Optimization for Diffusion Language Models
paper.abstract: Diffusion large language models (dLLMs) offer an efficient alternative to autoregressive models through parallel decoding, yet existing post-training methods largely rely on random masking strategies that overlook intrinsic token dependencies. In this work, we present an empirical analysis of attention in dLLMs and show that tokens attending more strongly to unmasked context exhibit greater generation stability and play a critical role in reasoning. Motivated by these findings, we propose AGDO,

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是 diffusion language model 在 post-training 阶段的一个结构性错配：训练时通常用 fully random masking 去决定哪些 token 被预测，但推理时模型是在多步 denoising 过程中逐步恢复 token，且每一步的可用上下文并不是随机形成的，而是由双向注意力下的真实依赖关系决定。作者想回答两个问题：一是 dLLM 在 denoising 过程中到底依赖哪些 token；二是能否把这种依赖显式写进 SFT 和 RL 的优化过程，而不是继续沿用对 AR 模型更自然、对 dLLM 其实并不贴合的随机掩码训练方式。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发不在于它提出了一个新的 base pretrain objective，而在于它把“full-attention masked/diffusion LM 的训练目标应当和真实生成轨迹对齐”这件事讲得更具体了。现有很多 dLLM post-training 方法只是把 AR 时代的 token-level 优化思路搬过来，再配一个随机 mask 或人为规定的解码顺序。这里的贡献是给出了一套来自模型内部 attention 结构的顺序信号，并把它同时用于 denoising order 和 loss/reward reweighting。对做 any-order LM、masked LM、diffusion LM 的人，这篇文章的价值在于：它提示 post-train recipe 不能只看目标函数形式，还要看生成轨迹是否与模型内部依赖结构一致。
summary.technical_approach:
方法分两层。第一层是 attention analysis。作者在 Dream-v0-Instruct-7B 上沿 denoising trajectory 跟踪最后一层 attention，发现两个现象：其一，attention 在 masked generation 中是稀疏且跨 step 相对稳定的，单个 token 往往持续依赖少量上下文 token；其二，如果某个待生成 token 对“已经被去噪出来的 token”有更高 attention mass，那么它在后续 step 的预测概率更稳定，说明它更适合在当前阶段被恢复。这个观察直接否定了 fully random masking 的一个隐含假设：所有 masked token 在当前 step 的可预测性近似同质。

第二层是 AGDO 框架。核心做法是先从 valid attention score 中构造 attention-guided denoising order，再把这个顺序用于 post-training。这里的 valid attention 可以理解为：只统计指向当前可见、已解码或未被 mask 的上下文 token 的注意力，从而估计某个 masked token 当前是否已经拥有足够支撑它被恢复的上下文。AGDO 不是按固定位置顺序解码，也不是简单 blockwise，而是按 attention 支撑度决定谁先被 unmask。

在 SFT 阶段，AGDO-SFT 用 attention-guided order 构造训练样本和预测目标，减少训练-推理错配。除此之外，作者还引入 attention-based reweighting，对 attention-critical token，也就是在依赖图中更像 hub、对其他 token 预测更关键的 token，赋予更高损失权重。这样做的理由很直接：这些 token 一旦预测错，会沿后续 denoising step 传播错误。

在 RL 阶段，AGDO-RL 建立在已有 dLLM 的 GRPO/mean-field 近似路线之上，但同样把 attention-guided order 和 token reweighting 纳入优化。也就是说，它不是只在 sample-level 上根据最终 reward 调整，而是让 credit assignment 更偏向那些对后续推理链条更关键的 token。和 diff-GRPO、wd1 这类方法相比，区别不在 RL 框架本身，而在于它把 policy optimization 的作用位置从“随机选中的 masked token”改成了“按 attention 依赖组织起来的 token 子集”。
summary.experiments:
从给出的全文内容看，实验主轴放在数学和代码推理任务上，核心结论是 AGDO 在这两类需要多步依赖传播的任务上稳定优于随机 masking 的 post-training 方法，以及优于外部规定顺序的若干变体。正文明确提到主要分析模型是 Dream-v0-Instruct-7B，并在附录上验证到 LLaDA，说明结论不是单模型特例。

更值得注意的是实验设计背后的因果链，而不只是最终分数。作者先用 MATH-500 做 attention tracing，展示 attention map 在 denoising step 间的时间一致性，以及“更多依赖已解码 token 的位置，其生成概率更稳定”这一统计关系。这个分析相当于给后续方法提供了机制证据。随后在 SFT 和 RL 两个阶段分别比较 random masking、blockwise 或 left-to-right 等顺序策略，结论是 attention-guided order 更适合 full-attention dLLM。消融上，应该重点看两类：一类是只改 denoising order、不做 reweighting；另一类是保留 order、去掉 attention-based token weighting。若两者都带来增益，说明收益既来自轨迹对齐，也来自更合理的 credit assignment。

由于提供的全文片段没有完整表格和具体 benchmark 数字，无法可靠复述精确提升幅度、训练 token 数或 RL 采样规模；但从论文叙述看，作者强调的是 consistent improvement 而不是单点大幅跃升，说明方法更像 recipe 改进而非架构替换。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读时先看 Introduction 和 Attention Analysis。这里决定这篇文章是否值得继续读：如果你认同“dLLM 的 token 依赖应由 attention 而不是位置先验决定”，后面的算法就顺理成章。然后看方法部分里 attention-guided denoising order 的定义，重点弄清楚 valid attention score 是如何计算的、顺序是按 step 动态更新还是一次性预估、训练时如何避免信息泄漏。再看 AGDO-SFT 与 AGDO-RL 的损失设计，尤其是 token reweighting 的公式和它与 mean-field RL 近似如何兼容。

实验部分建议优先看：1）attention 可视化与稳定性统计；2）不同 unmasking order 的对比；3）去掉 reweighting 的消融；4）数学与代码任务上是否都成立。如果时间有限，30 到 40 分钟足够抓住主线。若要深挖，值得追问两个点：第一，attention 是否真能作为依赖因果的代理，还是只是相关信号；第二，这套方法在 base pretraining 阶段是否也能成立，而不只是 post-training recipe。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a structural mismatch in post-training diffusion language models. Most existing dLLM post-training methods optimize randomly masked positions, while inference proceeds through iterative denoising where the available context is formed by the model’s evolving bidirectional dependencies rather than by random masking. The paper asks two concrete questions: what token dependencies actually emerge during denoising, and whether SFT/RL can be aligned to those dependencies instead of inheriting masking schemes that are convenient but poorly matched to full-attention dLLMs.
summary_en.importance: Its value for pretraining researchers is not a new base objective, but a sharper formulation of training-trajectory alignment for non-AR language models. Many diffusion or masked LM post-training recipes still borrow token-level optimization patterns from AR models and then add random masks or externally imposed decoding orders. This work argues that the denoising trajectory should be induced by the model’s own attention structure. That is useful for diffusion LM, any-order LM, and masked LM research because it shifts the discussion from objective form alone to the interaction between objective, decoding path, and internal dependency structure.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method has two layers. First is an empirical attention study. On Dream-v0-Instruct-7B, the authors trace final-layer attention along the denoising trajectory and report two main findings: attention is sparse and temporally stable across steps, and tokens that place more attention mass on already-denoised context exhibit more stable generation probabilities. This suggests that masked tokens are not equally predictable at a given step, which directly challenges fully random masking.

Second is AGDO, an attention-guided denoising and optimization framework. It derives an attention-guided denoising order from valid attention scores, where the key idea is to estimate whether a masked token already has enough support from currently visible or denoised context. Instead of decoding by position or by random selection, AGDO unmasks tokens according to attention-supported readiness.

AGDO-SFT uses this order during supervised fine-tuning, reducing the mismatch between training and inference trajectories. On top of that, it introduces attention-based reweighting: tokens that act more like attention hubs receive larger loss weights because mistakes on them are more likely to propagate through later denoising steps.

AGDO-RL extends the same principle to reinforcement learning. It stays within the recent dLLM RL line based on GRPO-style optimization with mean-field approximations, but changes where optimization pressure is applied. Rather than treating randomly masked positions as the optimization target, it organizes token-level credit assignment around attention-induced dependencies and emphasizes attention-critical tokens. Relative to methods like diff-GRPO or wd1, the novelty is less about the RL backbone and more about aligning policy optimization with the model’s intrinsic denoising structure.
summary_en.experiments:
From the provided full text, the experimental focus is on math and coding reasoning benchmarks, with the main claim being consistent gains over random-masking post-training baselines and over externally imposed decoding orders. The primary analysis is conducted on Dream-v0-Instruct-7B, with validation on LLaDA in the appendix, which suggests the observations are not tied to a single model family.

The more important part is the causal chain in the experiments. The paper first uses MATH-500 to trace attention maps across denoising steps and shows temporal consistency in attention as well as a statistical link between reliance on already-denoised tokens and probability stability. That analysis serves as mechanism evidence for the later algorithm. The downstream comparisons then evaluate random masking, blockwise orders, and left-to-right style orders against attention-guided denoising in both SFT and RL settings. The expected ablations to focus on are: changing only the denoising order while keeping the rest fixed, and removing attention-based token reweighting while preserving the order. If both matter, the gains come from both trajectory alignment and better token-level credit assignment.

The excerpt does not include the full result tables, so precise benchmark numbers, training-token counts, or RL sampling budgets cannot be stated reliably. The framing in the text suggests the contribution is a robust recipe improvement rather than a one-off large jump.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Start with the Introduction and the attention analysis section. That is where the paper either lands or does not: if you buy the claim that token dependencies in full-attention dLLMs should be inferred from attention rather than from positional priors, the rest follows naturally. Then read the method section carefully, especially how valid attention scores are defined, whether the denoising order is recomputed dynamically or estimated once, and how the training setup avoids leakage. After that, inspect the AGDO-SFT and AGDO-RL objectives, with special attention to the token reweighting formula and how it fits the mean-field RL approximation.

In the experiments, prioritize: 1) attention visualizations and stability statistics, 2) comparisons across unmasking orders, 3) ablations removing reweighting, and 4) whether the effect holds for both math and coding. For a skim, 30–40 minutes is enough to capture the main idea. For deeper reading, two questions are worth pursuing: whether attention is a causal proxy for dependency or only a correlated signal, and whether the same principle could be pushed into base pretraining rather than only post-training.

recommendation.zh: Diffusion LM 圈里少有的把 attention 结构真正用到训练/去噪 order 的工作；重点看 §3 的 attention 观察和 §4 的 token 加权 RL，别被“SOTA”措辞带跑。
recommendation.en: One of the cleaner dLLM papers that actually uses internal attention to change denoising order and loss weighting; read §3–§4 for the attention observations, ignore the headline SOTA framing.

institutions: Beijing Key Laboratory of Research on Large Models and Intelligent Governance
Gaoling School of Artificial Intelligence, Renmin University of China

paper.title: RoVE: Rotary Value Embeddings Attention for Relative Position-dependent Value Pathways
paper.abstract: Rotary Position Embeddings (RoPE) make attention scores position-relative but leave the value pathway position-blind: the message sent by a value token is the same regardless of its distance from the query. We propose RoVE, a parameter-free modification that makes values position-sensitive by rotating them simultaneously with keys, and show that it turns RoPE attention into attentive convolution. This new perspective unifies several independent formulations of the same operation across computer

summary.core_problem: RoPE 只让 attention score 具备相对位置信息，但 value 路径仍然对距离不敏感，导致模型在长程聚合和位置相关消息传递上存在结构性缺口。
summary.importance: 这是一个架构层面的干预，不改参数量、几乎不改训练配方，却直接触碰了 RoPE 设计里长期被默认接受的 value-blind 假设。对长上下文、OOD 泛化和 ICL 的改进如果成立，会影响后续位置编码与 attention 机制的默认实现。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 RoVE（Rotary Value Embeddings），核心做法是在对 key 使用旋转位置编码的同时，也对 value 施加同步旋转，使 query 接收的信息随相对位置而变化。作者给出理论视角：这样一来，RoPE attention 可被解释为一种 attentive convolution，把若干在 CV、机器人和 LLM 中分散出现的操作统一到同一形式下。方法是 parameter-free 的，重点不是加新模块，而是修正 value pathway 的位置建模。
summary.experiments: 在 124M 和 354M 的 GPT-2 规模模型上训练并评测。相对标准 RoPE，RoVE 在 few-shot in-context learning、OOD perplexity 和 long-context retrieval 上都有一致提升，提升最明显的场景是需要长距离信息聚合的任务。摘要未给出具体增幅，也未显示是否在更大模型或主流开源基座上复现，因此当前更像一个干净但中等规模的架构信号。

summary_en.core_problem: RoPE makes attention scores relative-position aware, but leaves the value pathway distance-blind, creating a structural gap for long-range aggregation and position-dependent message passing.
summary_en.importance: This is an architectural intervention that changes no parameter count and barely touches the training recipe, yet questions a long-accepted assumption in RoPE: position-aware scores with position-blind values. If the gains hold, it matters for default choices in positional encoding and attention design.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper proposes RoVE (Rotary Value Embeddings), which rotates values alongside keys so that the message received by a query depends on relative position. The authors further show that this turns RoPE attention into a form of attentive convolution, unifying several independently developed formulations across vision, robotics, and LLM architectures. The contribution is not a new module stack but a parameter-free correction to positional modeling in the value path.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments are run on GPT-2 style models at 124M and 354M parameters. Compared with standard RoPE, RoVE shows consistent gains on few-shot in-context learning, out-of-distribution perplexity, and long-context retrieval, with the clearest improvements on tasks requiring long-range aggregation. The abstract does not provide exact margins or evidence on larger frontier-scale models, so this currently reads as a clean medium-scale signal rather than a settled default.

recommendation.zh: 这篇值得看，因为它直接挑战了“RoPE 只改 score 就够了”的默认前提；先看理论推导和长程检索实验，若你在做长上下文架构，建议尽快做一次最小复现。
recommendation.en: Worth reading because it directly questions the default assumption that RoPE only needs to modify scores; read the theory and long-context retrieval first, and if you work on context extension, run a minimal ablation soon.

paper.title: Kuramoto Attention: Synchronizing Self-Attention on the Torus
paper.abstract: We introduce Kuramoto attention, a self-attention layer in which each hidden coordinate is an angle. The layer scores tokens by gated cosine similarity, attends over previous phase states, and updates each token by the tangent component of the attention-weighted circular mean. Because the values are the raw phase states, this update is exactly the Kuramoto coupling term $\sum_u A_{t,u}\sin(θ_u-θ_t)$, with the attention matrix acting as an adaptive, content-dependent coupling kernel. Equivalently

summary.core_problem: 提出一种把 hidden coordinate 视为角度变量的自注意力层，用相位同步动力学替代普通向量空间的 value 聚合。
summary.importance: 贡献是架构和建模形式上的尝试：将 Kuramoto 耦合、紧致群上的不变相似度和 on-manifold mean 引入 self-attention。它有形式新意，但从摘要看尚不能判断是否能在真实语言模型规模上成立。
summary.technical_approach: Kuramoto attention 用 gated cosine similarity 给 token 打分，对历史 phase state 做注意力，并用 attention 加权圆均值的切向分量更新当前 token。由于 value 是原始 phase state，更新项等价于 Kuramoto coupling；softmax 权重也可解释为熵正则化 phase-retrieval 问题的解。RoPE 被解释为位置依赖的相位偏移。
summary.experiments: 摘要主要描述层定义和数学解释，未给出参数规模、训练语料、语言建模困惑度、长上下文结果或与标准 attention 的效率/效果对比。
summary.authors_note: 作者机构信息显示为 Indiana University Bloomington。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper proposes a self-attention layer where hidden coordinates are angular variables and token interactions are modeled through phase synchronization.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is architectural: it imports Kuramoto coupling, invariant similarity on compact groups, and on-manifold averaging into attention. The formulation is interesting, but the abstract does not establish whether it works at practical language-model scale.
summary_en.technical_approach: Kuramoto attention scores tokens with gated cosine similarity, attends over previous phase states, and updates each token using the tangent component of an attention-weighted circular mean. Because values are raw phase states, the update is exactly a Kuramoto coupling term. The softmax weights are interpreted as solving an entropy-regularized phase-retrieval problem, and RoPE appears as a position-dependent phase shift.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract focuses on the layer definition and mathematical interpretation. It does not report model sizes, training corpora, language modeling perplexity, long-context behavior, or efficiency comparisons against standard attention.
summary_en.authors_note: The listed institution is Indiana University Bloomington.

recommendation.zh: 形式上有意思，但先别当可训练替代件；只看层定义和是否有 LM ablation。
recommendation.en: Formally interesting, but not yet a drop-in attention replacement; read the layer definition and check for real LM ablations.

paper.title: Attention-Discounted Adaptive Sampler for Masked Diffusion Language Models
paper.abstract: Masked diffusion language models can reduce inference steps by revealing multiple tokens per denoising iteration, but this parallelism is fragile: positions that are individually confident may be unsafe to commit together when their predictions are coupled. Existing training-free samplers such as Top-\(k\), Fast-dLLM, and EB-Sampler mainly control how many tokens to reveal, while often ranking candidates by token-wise scores that ignore interactions within the selected set. We propose ADAS, a tr

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是 masked diffusion language model 在并行解码时的一个具体薄弱点：模型可以在一步里同时揭掉多个 mask，但“单点置信度高”不等于“这些位置适合一起提交”。现有 Top-k、Fast-dLLM、EB-Sampler 这类 training-free sampler，主要控制每一步揭多少 token，排序依据却大多还是逐位置分数，如最大概率、margin 或 entropy。论文指出，真正导致低步数区间质量掉得快的，不只是模型本身预测错，而是 joint dependence error：若两个位置的预测彼此耦合，同时提交会放大错误。作者要解决的不是重新训练模型，也不是重新设计完整 decoding framework，而是在不改 stopping rule 的前提下，把“位置间相容性”引入 subset construction。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的意义主要有两层。第一，它补上了 MDLM 推理侧一个很实际的缺口：并行解码的瓶颈不只在 schedule 或 reveal budget，还在 subset ranking 是否 dependency-aware。这个判断对 diffusion LM / masked LM 范式很关键，因为这类模型的卖点就是低 NFE 下的并行生成，如果 subset 选择机制不稳，训练阶段学到的条件分布优势很难在推理时兑现。第二，这篇工作给出一个很轻量的接口：不改模型、不加 verifier、不做 lookahead search，只替换 greedy ranking，就能在多个 sampler 上稳定获益。这说明 MDLM 的推理质量还有不少“算法层面的可回收损失”，不一定都要靠更大模型或额外训练去补。量级上，它更像是一个 decoding primitive，而不是新的建模范式；但对正在评估 MDLM 实用性的研究者，这类 primitive 很重要。
summary.technical_approach:
方法核心是 ADAS，Attention-Discounted Adaptive Sampler。它保留原 sampler 的 stopping rule，只改“下一个把哪个位置加入当前 reveal set”。起点仍是每个 masked position 的 token-wise base score，通常是该位置 top-1 token 的置信度。不同于直接按这个分数排序，ADAS 采用贪心构造：已经选入集合 S 的位置，会对剩余候选位置 i 施加一个折扣，折扣大小取决于 i 对 S 中位置的 attention 强度，以及这些已选位置自身还剩多少不确定性。直观上，如果候选位置 i 强依赖某个已经准备一起提交、但其实还不够稳的位置 j，那么 i 的边际价值应被下调，因为把 i 和 j 同时 commit 的风险高于它们单独看时的风险。

从形式上看，作者把 subset selection 解释为一个非加性 utility 的贪心近似：单点 confidence 提供 individual utility proxy，attention 提供 pairwise compatibility proxy。这样做和已有方法的区别很清楚。Top-k、Fast-dLLM、EB-Sampler 的差异主要在预算约束：固定揭 k 个、按 confidence threshold 停止、或满足 entropy budget；但它们默认候选之间近似独立。ADAS 不碰这些预算机制，而是把 ranking 从“独立打分”改成“条件边际打分”。

论文还专门说明为什么选 attention 作为 dependency proxy，而不是显式图搜索或额外 verifier。原因是 attention 在一次前向里就可得，几乎零额外建模成本；同时在 controlled diagnostic 中，masked-token self-attention 对 dependent / non-dependent pair 有可分性。实现上，ADAS 只在每步构造 reveal subset 时做贪心更新，因此可以直接插到现有 sampler 中。作者强调其额外运行时开销只有每次 model forward 约 3.1%，这也是它比 lookahead / planning 类方法更容易落地的地方。
summary.experiments:
实验围绕两个问题展开：一是 joint dependence 是否真实存在且可被 attention 捕捉；二是 ADAS 在低 NFE 区间是否稳定改善质量。

诊断实验里，作者构造了耦合位置的受控任务。结果显示，把两个相关 literal 强制一起预测时，准确率从 71% 降到 30%，说明“单点能做对”并不代表“并行一起做也对”。同时，masked-token self-attention 在 dependent pair 与 non-dependent pair 之间呈现明显差异，为 attention-discount 机制提供了经验支撑。

主实验覆盖两类 MDLM：LLaDA-8B-Base 和 Dream-7B-Base；任务集中在数学推理和代码生成，共四个 benchmark。评测方式不是只看单一 operating point，而是在 matched denoiser-evaluation budget 下比较，也就是控制 NFE 后看质量。结果上，ADAS 加到 Top-k、EB-Sampler、Fast-dLLM 后，在高度并行、低 NFE 区间收益最明显。按 stopping criteria 平均，LLaDA-8B-Base 上 matched-NFE performance 平均提升 9.11 个点，Dream-7B-Base 上平均提升 10.46 个点；90 个 matched operating points 里有 80 个是正增益。这个结果说明收益不是某个 sampler 或某个任务上的偶然现象。

从论文给出的结论看，ADAS 的优势主要集中在 aggressive parallel decoding。随着 NFE 变大、每步揭示更保守，token-wise ranking 的脆弱性下降，ADAS 的边际收益也会缩小。这一点很合理，也说明它解决的是并行提交错误，而不是模型本身的条件分布误差。消融上，值得注意的是作者没有把 stopping rule 和 ranking 混在一起改，而是证明只改 ranking 就足以带来稳定收益，这让结论更干净。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇适合泛读，但如果你在看 diffusion LM / masked LM 的推理问题，建议把引言、方法和实验前三节认真看完。优先看三部分：

1. Introduction 里的问题设定。重点不是“又一个 sampler”，而是作者把 failure mode 定义成 joint dependence error，并明确区分 ranking 与 stopping rule。
2. 受控诊断实验和 attention 分析图表。这里决定了方法是否站得住：如果 attention 不能区分依赖关系，整个 discount 设计就会比较牵强。
3. 主结果表里按 matched NFE 比较不同 sampler 的部分。要看它是否在多个 operating point 上都有效，而不是只挑一个速度点。

阅读时可以带着两个问题：第一，attention 作为 dependency proxy 是否足够稳，还是只在 reasoning/code 这类强结构任务上更有效；第二，若未来做 learned unmasking policy，ADAS 这种 pairwise discount 能否作为训练目标或 imitation target。预计 30-45 分钟可以抓住主要内容；若要复现，重点看算法伪代码和 runtime overhead 的实现细节。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a specific weakness of parallel decoding in masked diffusion language models: revealing multiple tokens per denoising step is only useful if those positions are safe to commit jointly. Existing training-free samplers such as Top-k, Fast-dLLM, and EB-Sampler mostly decide how many positions to reveal, but they still rank candidates with token-wise scores like confidence or entropy. That ignores interactions inside the selected subset. The paper argues that low-NFE degradation is not only about marginal prediction error, but also about joint dependence error: two positions may each look confident in isolation while being unsafe to finalize together. The goal is therefore not to redesign the whole decoder or retrain the model, but to make subset construction dependency-aware while leaving the stopping rule unchanged.
summary_en.importance: For pretraining-oriented readers, the value is mainly on the inference side of the MDLM paradigm. Masked diffusion LMs are attractive because they can trade more parallelism for fewer denoising evaluations, but that promise depends heavily on the decoding algorithm. This work shows that a meaningful part of the quality loss at low NFE comes from the sampler, not only from the base model. That matters because it suggests there is still recoverable headroom in diffusion-style language modeling without changing the training objective. The contribution is not a new modeling paradigm; it is a lightweight decoding primitive. Still, for anyone evaluating whether MDLMs can be practical alternatives to autoregressive LMs, this kind of primitive is important because it improves the speed-quality frontier with almost no extra training cost.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method, ADAS (Attention-Discounted Adaptive Sampler), keeps the original sampler’s stopping rule and changes only the ranking step used to build the reveal set. It starts from the usual token-wise base score for each masked position, typically the confidence of the top predicted token. Instead of sorting positions independently by that score, ADAS builds the subset greedily. Once some positions have already been selected, each remaining candidate is discounted according to how strongly it attends to those selected positions and how uncertain those selected positions still are. Intuitively, if candidate i depends heavily on an already selected but still fragile position j, then the marginal value of committing i in the same step should be reduced.

The paper frames this as greedy construction under a non-additive subset utility: confidence acts as an individual utility proxy, while attention acts as a pairwise compatibility proxy. This is the key distinction from prior samplers. Top-k, Fast-dLLM, and EB-Sampler differ mostly in their budget constraints: fixed cardinality, confidence threshold, or entropy budget. They do not make the value of adding one position depend on which other positions are already in the subset. ADAS does exactly that, while remaining plug-compatible with all three.

A notable design choice is using attention as the dependency signal instead of explicit search, planning, or a verifier. The reason is practical: attention is already available from a single forward pass, so the method adds almost no modeling complexity. The paper also provides empirical evidence that masked-token self-attention separates dependent from non-dependent pairs in controlled settings. Implementation-wise, ADAS only modifies the greedy subset construction inside each denoising step, which is why it can be inserted into existing samplers with about 3.1% runtime overhead per model forward.
summary_en.experiments:
The empirical section addresses two questions: whether joint dependence is a real failure mode, and whether ADAS improves quality in the low-NFE regime where aggressive parallelism matters most.

In the controlled diagnostic, the authors force the model to predict coupled literals jointly. Accuracy drops from 71% to 30%, showing that good marginal predictions do not imply safe joint commitment. They also show that masked-token self-attention differs between dependent and non-dependent token pairs, which supports the use of attention as a discount signal.

The main evaluation uses two MDLMs, LLaDA-8B-Base and Dream-7B-Base, on four benchmarks covering mathematical reasoning and code generation. The comparison is done at matched denoiser-evaluation budgets rather than at a single operating point, which is the right way to evaluate speed-quality tradeoffs. Adding ADAS to Top-k, EB-Sampler, and Fast-dLLM consistently improves performance, especially in the highly parallel low-NFE regime. Averaged across stopping criteria, ADAS improves matched-NFE performance by 9.11 points on LLaDA-8B-Base and 10.46 points on Dream-7B-Base. It yields positive gains on 80 out of 90 matched operating points.

The pattern of gains is also informative. The benefit is strongest when decoding is aggressive and token-wise ranking is most brittle. As NFE increases and decoding becomes more conservative, the advantage shrinks, which is consistent with the paper’s claim that ADAS addresses joint commitment errors rather than the model’s underlying conditional prediction quality. An important experimental choice is that the authors isolate ranking from stopping: they do not jointly tune both, so the observed gains are easier to attribute to dependency-aware subset construction itself.
summary_en.reading_guide:
This is a skim paper, but it is worth a careful read if you are tracking diffusion or masked language modeling beyond autoregressive decoding. Focus on three parts.

First, read the introduction closely. The key idea is not merely “another sampler,” but the separation between stopping rules and subset ranking, and the claim that joint dependence error is the real bottleneck in aggressive parallel decoding.

Second, inspect the controlled diagnostic and the attention analysis. Those sections determine whether the method has a real mechanism behind it. If attention were not predictive of dependency, the whole discounting rule would be much less convincing.

Third, look at the matched-NFE result tables and plots. The important question is whether gains hold across many operating points and multiple samplers, not whether one cherry-picked speed setting improves.

A useful reading lens is to ask whether attention is a sufficiently robust proxy for dependency, or whether this works mainly on structured tasks like reasoning and code. Another good question is whether ADAS could serve as a target or inductive bias for learned unmasking policies. Around 30-45 minutes should be enough to extract the main ideas.

recommendation.zh: 读方法和 ablation 即可；它把 MDLM 加速问题从“揭示几个”推进到“哪些 token 可一起提交”。
recommendation.en: Read the method and ablations; it reframes MDLM acceleration from “how many tokens to reveal” to “which tokens are safe to commit together.”

paper.title: Blurry Window Attention
paper.abstract: The Softmax Attention operation in Transformer language models has a quadratic complexity in the sequence length and a growing state size in the form of KV cache, which becomes a bottleneck in long context scenarios. To overcome this limitation, alternative architectures with linear complexity and finite state size have been introduced, such as State-Space Models (SSMs), Linear Attention (LA), and Attention with Bounded-memory Control (ABC). Though linear models achieve similar language perplexi

summary.core_problem: 长上下文语言模型需要降低注意力的二次复杂度和不断增长的 KV cache，但现有线性模型在需要精确召回的任务上常弱于 softmax attention；BLA 试图在有限状态预算下保留一部分可检索的历史信息。
summary.importance: 这篇工作的启发点在于把 SWA 的“时间窗口”改写成一个频域压缩状态。它不是常见的 linear attention 外积记忆，也不是简单丢弃窗口外 token，而是用有限 Fourier mode 保存一段历史的模糊重建。对预训练研究的意义主要在架构方向：如果这类有限状态 attention 能在真实 LM 训练中保持困惑度和召回能力，就可能成为长上下文模型中介于 SWA、SSM、linear attention 之间的组件。当前证据仍偏早期，主要来自合成召回任务，还不能说明大规模语言预训练中的稳定收益。
summary.technical_approach: BLA 的核心做法是维护 key 和 value 的分离状态，而不是像 linear attention 那样存储 key-value 外积。写入时，新的 key 和 value 会分别乘到一组 Fourier 基上并累积，相当于在有限频率集合中保存历史序列的低频表示。读取时，通过 Dirichlet kernel 或类似插值方式从频域状态中重建一个“模糊”的时间域 KV 窗口，然后用当前 query 对这些重建的 key/value 做 softmax attention。这样做保留了 softmax attention 的匹配形式，但把存储从精确 KV 序列改成固定大小的频域摘要。与 SWA 相比，它不只记最近 w 个精确 token，而是用同等或更小状态覆盖更长历史；与 ABC/GSA 相比，它的写入机制更接近对窗口的频域泛化；与 SSM 相比，它仍显式构造可被 query 检索的 key/value 结构。
summary.experiments: 给出的实验重点是 recall-intensive synthetic tasks。作者报告 BLA 相比 SWA 有约 8× 的状态效率优势，即在相近召回表现下需要更小状态。MQAR 上，BLA 接近一些流行线性模型；RegBench 上，BLA 的表现接近 full attention，而 Gated Linear Attention 和 Gated DeltaNet 在该设定下明显不足。小状态预算下，BLA 优于 SWA。需要注意的是，提供的正文没有显示大规模 LM 预训练、真实长文档困惑度、下游长上下文 QA 或推理 benchmark 的完整结果，因此实验结论更适合作为架构可行性信号，而不是完整训练 recipe 依据。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 20–30 分钟。重点看方法部分中频域状态的写入、插值重建和读取公式，确认它的复杂度、状态大小和是否支持高效并行训练。实验部分重点看 MQAR、RegBench 的状态预算曲线，而不是只看单点指标。值得深挖的问题有三个：频率数量和窗口周期如何选；模糊重建对精确 key matching 的破坏有多大；在多层 LM 中是否需要和局部 SWA 或少量 full attention 混合使用。

summary_en.core_problem: Long-context LMs need to reduce quadratic attention cost and the growing KV cache, but existing finite-state or linear-time alternatives often lose on exact recall. BLA targets this gap by storing a compressed, query-addressable history.
summary_en.importance: The useful idea is a frequency-domain version of a sliding KV window. Instead of dropping old tokens as in SWA or storing key-value outer products as in linear attention, BLA keeps a fixed-size spectral summary from which a blurred KV history can be reconstructed. For pretraining research, this is an architecture probe for long-context models: it may offer a middle ground between local attention, SSM-style memory, and softmax retrieval. The current evidence is still preliminary because the reported results are mainly on synthetic recall benchmarks rather than large-scale LM pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: BLA maintains separate key and value states. Incoming keys and values are independently accumulated against a finite set of Fourier modes, similar in spirit to diagonal SSM representations such as S4D. At read time, the model interpolates these spectral states back into a lossy time-domain KV window using Dirichlet-kernel-style reconstruction, then applies standard softmax attention from the current query to the reconstructed keys and values. This preserves the softmax matching operation while replacing the exact KV buffer with a fixed-size compressed state. Compared with SWA, it trades exact recent memory for a longer blurred history. Compared with ABC or GSA, the write mechanism is a frequency-window generalization rather than a learned slot update. Compared with SSMs, it still exposes key/value-like objects to the query.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation focuses on recall-heavy synthetic tasks. The authors report about 8× better state efficiency than SWA. On MQAR, BLA approaches popular linear models. On RegBench, it reaches performance close to full attention, while GLA and Gated DeltaNet lag in the reported setting. Under small state budgets, BLA outperforms SWA. The provided content does not show large-scale language-model pretraining, real long-document perplexity, or downstream long-context QA results, so the experiments should be read as an architectural feasibility check rather than a complete recipe for replacing attention in LLMs.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20–30 minutes. Focus on the equations for spectral writing, time-domain interpolation, and query-time softmax reading. Then check the state-size and complexity analysis. In the experiments, read the MQAR and RegBench curves as a function of memory budget rather than isolated scores. The main questions to keep in mind are how the number of Fourier modes is chosen, how much exact retrieval is lost during interpolation, and whether BLA needs to be mixed with local or occasional full attention layers in real LMs.

recommendation.zh: ABC 家族的一个新变体，核心看点是用 Dirichlet 核在频域做插值重建 KV；对做长上下文推理/有界记忆注意力的人值得看 §3 的推导。
recommendation.en: A new ABC-family variant; the key idea is frequency-domain KV reconstruction via Dirichlet-kernel interpolation. Worth reading §3 if you work on bounded-memory attention for long-context inference.

paper.title: OmniGen-AR: AutoRegressive Any-to-Image Generation
paper.abstract: Autoregressive (AR) models have demonstrated strong potential in visual generation, offering superior performance with simple architectures and optimization objectives. However, existing methods are typically limited to single-modality conditions, e.g., text, restricting their applicability in real-world scenarios that demand image synthesis from diverse controls. In this work, we present OmniGen-AR, a unified autoregressive framework for Any-to-Image generation. By discretizing various visual c

summary.core_problem: 解决自回归视觉生成模型通常只能处理单一条件模态的问题，尝试用一个统一 AR 模型支持 any-to-image 生成。
summary.importance: 贡献属于统一多条件视觉生成：把文本、空间信号和视觉上下文离散化后接入同一 AR 框架，并提出避免条件泄漏的注意力设计。对研究统一 token 空间和跨模态离散化有一定参考，但离 LLM 基座预训练仍有距离。
summary.technical_approach: OmniGen-AR 使用共享视觉 tokenizer 离散化多种视觉条件，再与文本 tokenizer 的 token 一起送入统一自回归模型；核心方法是 Disentangled Causal Attention，显式分离条件 token 与内容 token 的因果依赖，减少条件信息直接泄漏到生成内容的问题。
summary.experiments: 摘要覆盖 text-to-image、segmentation-to-image、depth-to-image、图像编辑、帧预测和 text-to-video 等多任务，说明实验重点是单模型多任务统一性。未给出参数量、数据规模和具体提升幅度；从摘要看，更像方法可行性展示而非大规模范式验证。

summary_en.core_problem: It addresses the limitation that autoregressive visual generators are usually tied to a single conditioning modality, aiming for a unified any-to-image AR model.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is in unified conditional visual generation: multiple control modalities are discretized into a shared token space, with an attention design to reduce information leakage. This is somewhat relevant to unified tokenization, but still peripheral to core LLM pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: OmniGen-AR discretizes diverse visual conditions with a shared visual tokenizer and combines them with text tokens in one autoregressive model. Its main technical idea is Disentangled Causal Attention, which separates dependencies between condition tokens and content tokens to mitigate leakage.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract claims support for text-to-image, segmentation-to-image, depth-to-image, image editing, frame prediction, and text-to-video in one model. No model size, data scale, or quantitative gains are given in the abstract, so it reads more like a unification demo than a large-scale paradigm shift.

recommendation.zh: 如果你关心统一离散 token 空间，可以只看 tokenizer 设计和 DCA；其余更像视觉生成整合，不足以改变文本基座训练的 prior。
recommendation.en: Read only the tokenizer setup and DCA if you care about unified discrete token spaces; the rest is mostly visual-generation unification, not a prior-changing pretraining result.

paper.title: P-Cast Precision in FP8 Attention: Sink-Induced Collapse and the Optimality of S=2^8
paper.abstract: FP8 (E4M3) acceleration for attention computation offers significant throughput gains, but the 3-bit mantissa introduces precision challenges when the softmax probability matrix~$P$ is cast to FP8 before the $P \cdot V$ matrix multiplication. We analyze two implementation choices that affect output precision under the \emph{Attention Sink} phenomenon: (1)~the KV block iteration order, and (2) the static scaling factor applied to $P$ before casting.   We show that forward KV iteration causes \emp

summary.core_problem: 该工作分析 FP8 attention 中把 softmax 概率矩阵 P cast 到 E4M3 时的精度失效：attention sink 会让前向 KV block 迭代中的大量非 sink 概率下溢为 0，而 P 的静态缩放因子决定失效阈值。
summary.importance: 这是一篇推理/低精度内核分析工作，对预训练研究的价值在于解释 FP8 attention 的数值边界。随着训练和推理都更依赖 FP8，P-cast 不再是实现细节，而会改变注意力输出误差。工作给出一个可计算诊断式 Δc = 6.93 + ln S - δk，用来判断某个 sink 强度、缩放因子和迭代顺序下是否会出现 P-collapse。它也解释了 FlashAttention-3/4 中 reverse KV iteration 和 S=256 这类工程选择为什么有效。
summary.technical_approach: 论文把单个 attention head 中的非 sink logit 近似为 N(0,1)，前 k_sink 个 token 作为 attention sink，其 logit 均值高出 Δ。前向 KV 迭代时，block 0 中的 sink 会先抬高 online softmax 的 running maximum。后续 block 的非 sink 概率近似为 exp(s_i - Δ - δ_k)，其中 δ_k 是 sink block 内最大值的极值修正；当 k_sink=4 时，δ_k 约为 1.03。E4M3 cast 后，若 S·P 低于最小可表示范围，就会下溢为 0。由此得到非 sink P 下溢比例 F(Δ,S)=Φ(Δ+δ_k-6.93-ln S)。这里 6.93=10 ln 2，来自 E4M3 的有效最小正数阈值。论文进一步说明 reverse iteration 可以避免 sink 在一开始污染 running maximum；配合 S=256，在实际序列长度下能让 P 值保持可表示。对缩放因子，作者定义 dp(S)，即归一化最大量化步长，发现它呈锯齿形，2 的幂位于较低包络上。S=256 同时满足 bit-exactness、较小量化步长和最大 normal 覆盖，因此比任意常数缩放更稳。
summary.experiments: 实验采用 kernel-faithful simulation，刻意匹配生产内核语义：P cast 前的 gSum 仍来自 FP32 概率，而不是量化后的 P。关键结果是两项修复同时使用时，MSE 改善约 3 到 10 倍，并出现误差饱和，说明主要失效源已经被消除。论文还给出阈值解释：S=1 时，若 k_sink=4，临界 sink 强度约为 Δc=6.93-1.03=5.90，容易进入 P-collapse；S=256 时，Δc 约为 11.45，实际模型中更难触发。E4M3 只有 3-bit mantissa，每个 binade 8 个可表示值，相对精度约 12.5%，约比 BF16 粗 16 倍，因此这些顺序和缩放选择会直接影响输出误差。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读预计 30 到 40 分钟。优先看第 3 节 P-collapse 推导，特别是 F(Δ,S)=Φ(Δ+δ_k-6.93-ln S) 和临界 Δc 的来源。然后看第 4 节 reverse iteration 的充分性论证，以及第 5 节 dp(S) 对 S=256 的刻画。第 6 节实验适合核对工程语义，尤其是 gSum 来自 FP32 pre-cast P 这一点。若只关心实践结论，可直接记住两条：reverse KV iteration 避免 sink 先抬高 running max；P cast 前用 S=256 能显著扩大可表示范围，同时保持较好的量化步长。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper analyzes a precision failure mode in FP8 attention: when the softmax probability matrix P is cast to E4M3 before the P·V matmul, attention sinks can cause many non-sink probabilities to underflow to zero, and the failure threshold depends strongly on KV block order and the static P scaling factor.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily a low-precision attention and inference-kernel analysis, but it matters for foundation-model training and serving because FP8 attention is becoming a standard throughput tool. The main value is a clean diagnostic for P-cast failure, Δc = 6.93 + ln S - δk, and a quantitative explanation of why reverse KV iteration and S=256 work well in FlashAttention-style kernels.
summary_en.technical_approach: The analysis models non-sink logits as standard normal variables and treats the first k_sink tokens as attention sinks whose logits are shifted upward by Δ. Under forward KV iteration, the first block contains the sink tokens, so the online softmax running maximum is set too high early in the scan. Probabilities in later blocks are then approximately exp(s_i - Δ - δ_k), where δ_k is the expected within-sink maximum; for k_sink=4, δ_k is about 1.03. A probability underflows after E4M3 casting if S·P is below the representable threshold, yielding the closed-form underflow fraction F(Δ,S)=Φ(Δ+δ_k-6.93-ln S). The paper also characterizes the scaling factor through dp(S), the normalized maximum quantization step. dp(S) has a sawtooth structure, with powers of two on the lower envelope. S=256 is singled out by three constraints: bit-exactness, small quantization step, and broad normal-range coverage.
summary_en.experiments: Validation uses a kernel-faithful simulation that preserves production semantics, including computing gSum from FP32 pre-cast probabilities rather than from quantized P. Applying reverse iteration together with S=256 gives about 3–10× lower MSE and then saturates, suggesting that the dominant P-cast error has been removed. The threshold calculation is also informative: with k_sink=4 and S=1, the collapse threshold is roughly Δc=5.90; with S=256 it moves to about Δc=11.45. This large shift explains why scaling is not a minor tuning constant in E4M3 attention.
summary_en.reading_guide: A useful skim takes about 30–40 minutes. Read the P-collapse derivation first, especially the underflow fraction and the critical Δ threshold. Then inspect the reverse-iteration argument and the dp(S) characterization of S=256. The simulation section is worth checking for implementation fidelity, particularly the treatment of gSum. For practical use, the main takeaway is simple: process KV blocks in reverse to avoid early sink domination, and scale P by 256 before E4M3 casting when using this kernel design.

recommendation.zh: 对FP8 attention实现有直接工程指导价值，结论清晰且有构造性证明；做推理引擎或训练优化时应检查是否采用反向迭代+S=256配置。
recommendation.en: Direct engineering guidance for FP8 attention implementation with constructive proof; inference/training engineers should verify reverse iteration + S=256 in their setups.

paper.title: Consistency Training Along the Transformer Stack
paper.abstract: Consistency training encourages models to behave similarly across different contexts, and has shown promise for reducing misalignment. We broaden the scope of consistency training in two ways. First, we introduce two new internal consistency targets: MLP Consistency Training (MLPCT), which matches post-activation MLP states, and Attention Consistency Training (AttCT), which matches per-head attention distributions. Second, we apply consistency training to four additional safety threats: persona

summary.core_problem: 大模型在面对语义相似但表述不同的 prompt（如越狱、阿谀奉承、预填充攻击等）时，容易表现出不一致的对齐失效。现有的一致性训练（Consistency Training）方法仅关注输出分布或残差流激活，未充分利用 Transformer 内部其他组件的表示。
summary.importance: 拓展了一致性训练的设计空间，证明了在 Transformer 的不同层级（MLP、Attention）施加一致性约束，能有效防御多种新型安全威胁，且不同层级的约束具有互补性，为提升模型对齐的鲁棒性提供了新视角。
summary.technical_approach: 提出了两种新的一致性训练目标：1) MLPCT：约束干净 prompt 和扰动 prompt 在 SwiGLU 激活后的 MLP 隐藏状态的余弦距离；2) AttCT：约束两者在每个注意力头的注意力权重分布的 Jensen-Shannon 散度。训练时，模型通过 SFT 学习在扰动下保持内部状态与干净 prompt 一致。
summary.experiments: 在角色扮演 ICL 攻击、预填充攻击、对抗性挫败和条件错位等四种新威胁模型上进行了评估。结果表明，MLPCT 和 AttCT 在所有威胁模型上均表现出竞争力。消融实验发现，不同层级的一致性目标在跨威胁泛化上表现不同，例如基于激活的方法在对抗性挫败上失效，而基于输出分布的 BCT 则表现良好，表明不同目标学习到了不同的防御机制。
summary.reading_guide: 建议重点阅读 Section 3 了解 MLPCT 和 AttCT 的具体实现细节，以及 Section 4 中对四种新威胁模型的定义和实验结果。关注不同一致性目标在跨威胁泛化上的差异分析，这部分对理解模型内部机制有启发。

summary_en.core_problem: Large language models often exhibit inconsistent alignment failures when faced with semantically similar prompts that differ in framing (e.g., jailbreaks, sycophancy, prefill attacks). Existing consistency training methods only focus on output distributions or residual stream activations, neglecting the representations of other internal Transformer components.
summary_en.importance: Expands the design space of consistency training, demonstrating that applying consistency constraints at different Transformer levels (MLP, Attention) effectively defends against various novel safety threats. The complementarity of these constraints provides a new perspective for enhancing the robustness of model alignment.
summary_en.technical_approach: Introduces two novel consistency training targets: 1) MLPCT: penalizes the cosine distance between post-activation MLP hidden states (SwiGLU) across clean and perturbed prompts; 2) AttCT: penalizes the Jensen-Shannon divergence of per-head attention weight distributions. During training, the model learns via SFT to maintain internal states consistent with the clean prompt under perturbations.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on four novel threat models: persona ICL attacks, prefill attacks, adversarial frustration, and conditional misalignment. Results show that MLPCT and AttCT are competitive across all threat models. Ablation studies reveal that different consistency targets exhibit varying cross-threat generalization. For instance, activation-based methods fail on adversarial frustration, while output distribution-based BCT performs well, indicating that different targets learn distinct defense mechanisms.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section 3 for the implementation details of MLPCT and AttCT, and Section 4 for the definitions and experimental results of the four novel threat models. Pay attention to the analysis of differences in cross-threat generalization among various consistency targets, which offers insights into the model's internal mechanisms.

recommendation.zh: 不是 pretrain 论文，但它把“对齐信号改写哪层表示”讲得比多数安全工作更具体；先看内部表征消融，若 setup 干净，可反哺 mid-train/annealing 设计。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but it is more concrete than most safety work on which layers alignment signals actually rewrite; read the internal-state ablations first and only trust it if the setup is clean.

paper.title: High-Dimensional Theory of LoRA Fine-Tuning in a Solvable Attention Model
paper.abstract: We develop a high-dimensional statistical theory of low-rank adaptation (LoRA) in attention models, capturing the interplay between pre-training and fine-tuning. We introduce a solvable framework in which a single-head attention layer is first pre-trained on a data-abundant task and subsequently adapted via a rank-one LoRA update on limited data. In the high-dimensional limit, both stages admit a sharp asymptotic characterization in terms of a finite set of order parameters, yielding explicit pr

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文研究 LoRA 微调在预训练之后为什么有效，以及预训练质量、预训练样本量、微调样本量如何共同决定 LoRA 的泛化。它不分析真实 Transformer 的完整复杂性，而是构造一个可解的高维 attention 模型，把 full-rank 预训练和 rank-one LoRA 微调放在同一个统计框架里。
summary.importance: 对大模型预训练的价值在于提供一个可计算的 pretrain-to-finetune 理论模型。它不是工程 recipe，也不能直接推出真实 LLM 的 LoRA 最优配置；但它把“预训练给微调留下了什么”压缩为 effective noise 这类可分析量，并给出测试误差、表示对齐、重构 overlap 的关系。这个角度对理解继续预训练、PEFT、数据质量和下游适配之间的取舍有启发。
summary.technical_approach: 论文使用一个单头 tied-attention layer。输入是长度为 T、维度为 D 的 token 序列。预训练阶段学习一个大秩矩阵 W，目标是 extensive-rank attention-indexed model；微调阶段冻结 W，只学习一个 rank-one LoRA 分量 w。模型包含 tied keys/queries、identity values，并考虑 row-wise softmax 或 rescaled identity activation。训练目标是带 L2 正则的经验风险，预训练样本数 N 较大，微调样本数 N' 较小。在 D、N、N'、P 按比例增长的高维极限下，作者把两个阶段的学习过程归约为有限个 scalar order parameters，用这些量预测预训练测试误差、LoRA 微调测试误差以及与真实目标的 overlap。相对 NTK 或 lazy-training 分析，这里关注 feature-learning regime；相对一般化界，它给的是 sharp asymptotic learning curve。
summary.experiments: 这是一篇理论论文，核心结果是高维极限下的显式表征和学习曲线预测，而不是大规模 LLM 实验。文中给出的主要现象包括：预训练对 LoRA 的影响可以通过一个 effective-noise 机制总结；预训练目标和正则强度会改变微调阶段可见的噪声水平；在某些区域，微调测试误差与重构 overlap 会出现不一致，即模型可以通过记忆预训练数据获得较好预测误差，但表示恢复质量并不好。根据提供内容，未看到真实语言模型或实际 LoRA adapter 的实验数字，因此不应把结论外推为工程定律。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 30 分钟。重点看 Section 2 的 two-stage model，确认 W、w、样本规模、attention activation 和正则项的设定。然后看 main theorem 或 order-parameter 方程，关注测试误差和 overlap 如何由少数标量决定。effective-noise 相关部分最值得细看，因为它直接连接预训练质量和微调表现。最后看 test error 与 reconstruction overlap mismatch 的例子。推导细节可以跳读，除非需要复现高维理论。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks how LoRA fine-tuning depends on the pre-training stage in a setting where the interaction can be solved analytically. Instead of modeling a full Transformer, it builds a high-dimensional attention model in which a large-rank component is pre-trained on abundant data and a rank-one LoRA component is later fitted on limited downstream data.
summary_en.importance: Its value is conceptual rather than immediately prescriptive. The paper provides a tractable pretrain-to-finetune theory for attention, with explicit predictions for test error and representation alignment. The most useful idea is that the effect of pre-training on LoRA can be summarized through an effective-noise mechanism.
